article_content: CNN — Three-time Indianapolis 500 winner Dario Franchitti announced his retirement on Thursday, one month after a devastating crash in Houston that left him with head and spinal injuries. In a statement released through his team, Target Chip Ganassi Racing, Franchitti said he decided to retire based on medical advice. 'They have made it very clear that the risks involved in further racing are too great and could be detrimental to my long-term well-being. Based on this medical advice, I have no choice but to stop,' he said. 'Racing has been my life for over 30 years, and it’s truly difficult to accept that the driving chapter is now over. I was eagerly looking forward to the 2014 season with Target Chip Ganassi Racing, with goals of winning a fourth Indianapolis 500 and a fifth IndyCar Series championship.' Franchitti suffered a concussion, as well as fractures to his spine and ankle. The crash occurred on the final lap of the IndyCar Grand Prix of Houston on October 6, when Japanese driver Takuma Sato made contact with Franchitti’s car, sending it airborne into the protective fencing. The vehicle spun multiple times along the barrier, releasing debris toward the grandstands and shearing off part of its side. Thirteen spectators were also injured in the incident. IndyCar has since announced it will review safety procedures following the crash. The Scottish driver won the Indianapolis 500 in 2007, 2010, and 2012. He ends his career with 31 IndyCar victories and 33 pole positions. 'I’ll forever look back on my time racing in CART and the IndyCar Series with fond memories, and the relationships I’ve built in the sport will last a lifetime,' he said. 'Hopefully, in time, I’ll be able to continue contributing to the IndyCar Series in some off-track capacity. I love open-wheel racing and want to see it succeed.' Franchitti was married to actress Ashley Judd for more than 11 years; the couple announced their separation in January.

article_content: Across parts of the UK, thousands of personal letters are going missing—left in bushes, tossed beside roads, or simply never delivered—due to practices by TNT Post, Royal Mail’s main private competitor. People are suffering real consequences: missed hospital visits, delayed medical test results, and unpaid bills piling up because vital correspondence never reached its destination. In Manchester and London, police and residents have discovered piles of undelivered mail hidden in dense undergrowth. One woman, Chris Elsdale, spent 12 days trying to get TNT Post to retrieve 250 letters she found near a reservoir in Brent. When they refused, citing thorny bushes, she waded in herself, gathered every letter, and finally got them collected. Only ten were junk mail—the rest included bank statements, hospital letters, and credit card notifications. Unlike Royal Mail, which is legally required to deliver 93% of first-class mail the next working day, TNT Post operates under no such mandate. Its delivery staff are paid based on speed, not completeness, creating a system where skipping stops or abandoning mail can mean higher earnings. The fallout extends beyond individuals. Harrow Council spent £13,000 re-sending council tax notices after TNT Post failed to deliver them to 24,000 homes. Salford City Council faced similar problems with 110,000 households. Meanwhile, Royal Mail workers say they’re forced to clean up TNT’s mess—pulling mail out of their own boxes, redirecting misplaced letters, and even giving directions to confused TNT drivers. Recipients who find TNT mail and drop it into a Royal Mail box are charged a £1.53 fee—adding insult to injury. Clare Yabsley, a mother in west London, missed two critical hospital letters regarding her daughter’s heart condition because TNT Post didn’t deliver them. She only found out when the hospital called to ask why she hadn’t shown up. TNT Post says it’s sorry for the distress and promises to fix problems—but critics argue that apologies aren’t enough. With the company aiming to serve 40% of UK households in three years, many fear these incidents are not exceptions—they’re symptoms of a broken model. Royal Mail, stripped of its monopoly since 2006, now handles only the ‘last mile’ for many competitors. But now, even that final leg is being outsourced to firms like TNT Post—leaving consumers caught between two systems, neither fully accountable, and paying the price.
translated_content: यूके को विभिन्न क्षेत्रहरूमा हजारौं व्यक्तिगत पत्रहरू खोइएका छन्—बुझाउँदै, सडकको किनारमा फेकिएका वा साधारणतया कहिल्यै पुगेका छन्—टीएनटी पोष्टले, रॉयल मेलको मुख्य निजी प्रतिस्पर्धी। मानिसहरूले वास्तविक परिणामहरू भोगिरहेका छन्: अस्पतालको भेट छोडिएको, चिकित्सा परीक्षणको परिणाम ढिलो भएको, र अनियमित बिलहरू जम्मा भएको किनभने महत्त्वपूर्ण संचार कहिल्यै पुगेको थिएन। म्यानचेस्टर र लन्डनमा, पुलिस र नागरिकहरूले घनो झाडीहरूमा अप्राप्त पत्रहरूको ढुङ्गा पाएका छन्। एउटा महिला, क्रिस एल्सडेल, ब्रेन्टमा एउटा तालाबको नजिक उनले पाएका २५० पत्रहरू टीएनटी पोष्टलाई फर्काउन १२ दिनसम्म प्रयास गरिन्। जब उनीहरूले झाडीहरू धेरै काँटेदार भएको भनेर अस्वीकार गरे, उनले आफैं झाडीमा जाएर सबै पत्रहरू सङ्कलन गरिन् र अन्ततः तिनीहरूलाई उठाइएको थियो। मात्र दश पत्रहरू जंक मेल थिए—शेष सबै बैंक विवरण, अस्पतालका पत्र र क्रेडिट कार्ड नोटिसहरू थिए। रॉयल मेल जस्तो जुन वैध रूपमा पहिलो श्रेणीका ९३ प्रतिशत पत्रहरू अर्को कार्यदिवसमा डेलिभर गर्न आवश्यक छ, टीएनटी पोष्टले त्यस्तो आवश्यकता छैन। यसका डेलिभरी स्टाफहरूलाई गति, वा पूर्णताको आधारमा तिर्ने गरिन्छ, जसले रोक छोड्ने वा पत्रहरू त्याग्ने एक व्यवस्था सिर्जना गर्छ जसले बढी कमाइ ल्याउन सक्छ। परिणामहरू व्यक्तिहरू मात्र होइनन्। हरो बरो लन्डनले टीएनटी पोष्टले २४,००० घरहरूमा जम्मा कर नोटिसहरू पुर्याएन भनेर लागत १३,००० पाउन्ड खर्च गर्यो। साल्फोर्ड सिटी काउन्सिलले १,१०,००० घरहरूमा समान समस्या भोग्यो। त्यस्तै, रॉयल मेलका कर्मचारीहरू भन्छन् कि उनीहरूले टीएनटीको गडबडी सफा गर्न बाध्य छन्—आफ्नै डाकबक्सबाट पत्र निकाल्ने, गलत ठाउँमा पुगेका पत्रहरू पुनः पठाउने, र भ्रमित टीएनटी ड्राइभरहरूलाई सडकको निर्देशन दिने। टीएनटी पत्र पाएर रॉयल मेलको डाकबक्समा राख्ने ग्राहकहरूलाई £१.५३ शुल्क लगाइन्छ—यो अतिरिक्त अपमान हो। वेस्ट लन्डनकी एउटा आमा, क्लेयर याब्सले, आफ्नी २० महिनाकी छोरीको हृदय अस्वस्थताको बारेमा दुई गम्भीर अस्पतालका पत्रहरू टीएनटी पोष्टले पुर्याएन भनेर छोडिन्। जब अस्पतालले उनी आउनुभएको छैन भनेर सोध्यो तब मात्र उनले थाहा पाइन्। टीएनटी पोष्टले असुविधा र दुःखको लागि क्षमा माग्छ र समस्या समाधान गर्ने वचन दिन्छ—तर आलोचकहरूले भन्छन् कि क्षमा अपर्याप्त छ। कम्पनीले तीन वर्षभित्र यूके को ४० प्रतिशत घरहरूलाई सेवा गर्ने लक्ष्य राखेको छ, धेरैले यी घटनाहरू अपवाद होइनन् भन्छन्—यो एउटा टूटेको मोडेलका लक्षणहरू हुन्। २००६ मा रॉयल मेलले डाक सेवाको एकाधिकार गुमाएको थियो। अब यो कम्पनीहरूको लागि केवल ‘अन्तिम माइल’ सम्हाल्छ। तर अहिले यो अन्तिम पाँचलाई पनि टीएनटी जस्ता कम्पनीहरूले सम्हाल्दैछन्—जसले उपभोक्ताहरूलाई दुई व्यवस्थाहरूबीचमा फसाएको छ, जसमध्ये कुनै पनि पूर्ण रूपमा जिम्मेवार छैन, र बिल तिर्नुपर्छ।

article_content: On the same day Mia Farrow suggested in a Vanity Fair interview that Frank Sinatra—rather than Woody Allen—might be Ronan Farrow’s biological father, reports emerged that the 25-year-old Yale Law graduate is in talks to host a weekend program on MSNBC. A Rhodes Scholar at Oxford University and former Special Adviser to the U.S. Secretary of State for Global Youth Issues, Farrow has become a familiar voice on MSNBC and CNN through his advocacy work and commentary on global youth issues, particularly in Africa. Sources within MSNBC indicate the network aims to refresh its brand and connect with younger viewers by adding dynamic, non-traditional hosts. Farrow would join a revamped weekend lineup that includes former Democratic strategist Karen Finney and Salon political writer Steve Kornacki. Farrow’s accomplishments are extraordinary: admitted to Yale Law at age 16, graduated from Bard College at 15, served as a UNICEF spokesperson from 2001 to 2009, and played a key role in establishing the Office of Global Youth Issues under Secretary of State Hillary Clinton during the Arab Spring. His journalism has appeared in major outlets including The Wall Street Journal, The Atlantic, and the International Herald Tribune. He co-authored a critical piece challenging the Congressional investigation into the 2012 Benghazi attack. Farrow has publicly severed ties with Woody Allen following Allen’s romantic relationship with Soon-Yi Previn, Mia’s adopted daughter. 'I cannot have a relationship with my father and be morally consistent,' Farrow stated. In response to the paternity rumors, Farrow tweeted with characteristic wit: 'Listen, we’re all possibly Frank Sinatra’s son.' Mia Farrow, now 68, described Sinatra as 'the great love of my life' and noted they never truly separated. Nancy Sinatra Jr. confirmed that Ronan has always been considered part of the Sinatra family. While MSNBC has not officially confirmed the hosting deal, President Phil Griffin has a history of taking risks on unconventional talent, as seen with Al Sharpton’s successful addition to the network in 2011. Farrow himself has not commented directly on the reports. He resigned from his State Department position after being named a Rhodes Scholar in 2013.

स्नातक रोनन फर्रोले एमएसएनबीसीमा साप्ताहिक कार्यक्रमको मेजबानी गर्न छलफल गर्दैछन् भन्ने समाचार आएको थियो। ओक्सफोर्ड विश्वविद्यालयका रोड्स विद्यार्थी र अमेरिकी राष्ट्रिय विदेश विभागका पूर्व विशेष सल्लाहकार रोनन फर्रोले विश्वका युवा समस्याहरू, विशेषगरी अफ्रिकामा आधारित आन्दोलन र टिप्पणीहरूका लागि एमएसएनबीसी र सीएनएनमा धेरै पटक उपस्थिति दिएका छन्। एमएसएनबीसीका स्रोतहरूले भन्छन् कि नेटवर्कले युवा दर्शकहरूलाई आकर्षित गर्न र आफ्नो प्रतिमान अद्यावधिक गर्न अन्यथा अनुभवहीन व्यक्तिहरूलाई मेजबानीको भूमिकामा राख्न चाहन्छ। रोनन फर्रो एक पुनर्निर्मित साप्ताहिक सूचीमा अग्रिम राजनीतिक सल्लाहकार क्यारेन फिनी र सलोनका राजनीतिक लेखक स्टिभ कर्नाकीलाई साथ गर्नेछन्। रोननका उपलब्धिहरू असाधारण छन्: १६ वर्षको उमेरमा येल विधि विद्यालयमा प्रवेश पाए, १५ वर्षको उमेरमा बार्ड कलेजबाट स्नातक भए, २००१ देखि २००९ सम्म युनिसेफका प्रवक्ता रहेका थिए र अरब वसन्तको समयमा सेक्रेटरी ऑफ स्टेट हिलेरी क्लिन्टनको सल्लाहकारको रूपमा विश्वव्यापी युवा मुद्दाको कार्यालय स्थापना गर्न महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेलेका थिए। उनका लेखहरू वॉल स्ट्रीट जर्नल, द अटलान्टिक र इन्टरनेशनल हर्डल ट्रिब्यूनमा प्रकाशित भएका छन्। २०१२ को बेंगाजी हमलाको कांग्रेसी जाँचको विरुद्ध उनले एक आक्रमक लेख सह-लेखन गरेका थिए। रोननले वुडी अलेनको आफ्नी दाजु भएकी सोन-यी प्रेविनसँगको रोमान्टिक सम्बन्धको कारण आफ्नो सम्बन्ध तोडेका छन्। 'म आफ्नो बाबुसँग सम्बन्ध राख्न सक्दिन र नैतिकतालाई संग राख्न सक्दिन।' रोननले भन्नुभएको थियो। पाटर्निटीका अफवाहहरूको प्रतिक्रियामा कि उनीहरू कहिल्यै विच्छेद भएनन्। नेन्सी सिनाट्रा जूनले पुष्टि गर्नुभएको थियो कि रोननलाई सिनाट्रा परिवारको अंग मानिन्छ। एमएसएनबीसीले यो होस्टिङको अफवाहलाई औपचारिक रूपमा पुष्टि गरेको छैन, तर अध्यक्ष फिल article_content: A 9-year-old autistic girl, Mikaela Lynch, has been missing for three days after running away from her family’s vacation home in Clearlake, Northern California. She was last seen on Sunday afternoon playing on a trampoline in the enclosed backyard when her younger brother inadvertently left the gate open. Mikaela, who is non-verbal and has the developmental level of a toddler, removed her clothes and shoes before running off. Her clothing and a diaper were later found in the yard and near a nearby waterway, respectively. Initially, authorities feared she might have entered the water, leading to a search by divers. However, surveillance footage from a neighbor’s camera showed her running away from the waterway and up the street — shifting the focus of the search inland. Her mother, Bari Lynch, unknowingly drove along the same route minutes later while searching for her, but did not locate her. Clearlake Police Lieutenant Tim Celli confirmed there is no evidence of abduction. Mikaela, who is described as curious, energetic, and drawn to climbing and exploring, is considered at high risk due to her condition. She is 4 feet tall, weighs 70 pounds, has blue eyes and brown hair, and does not respond when called. Residents are being asked to check both high and low locations — including sheds, crawl spaces, and wooded areas — as Mikaela often seeks out hidden spots. Anyone with information is urged to contact the Clearlake Police Department at 707-994-8251.

article_content: For over a year and a half, we’ve been answering questions about Facebook etiquette—and one concern keeps coming up: what do you do when a relative, boss, or elderly neighbor sends you a friend request you’d rather not accept? The dilemma is real: you don’t want them seeing your party photos or thinking of you as an 11-year-old, but you’re afraid they’ll notice if you decline—especially if they’re the type who notices everything. Here’s your no-nonsense guide to handling unwanted Facebook friend requests—with four practical options. Option 1: Ignore It. Facebook lets you quietly hide friend requests without rejecting them outright. Simply click 'Not now.' The requester won’t be notified, and they might assume you’re just not active online. It’s passive, but effective. Option 2: Accept—With Limits. If you must accept, use Facebook’s privacy tools to restrict what they see. Create a custom list called 'Limited Profile' or 'Work Contacts.' Then, under Privacy Settings > How You Connect, adjust who can see posts by others on your timeline. You’ll also need to manually restrict photo visibility separately. It’s clunky, but if your boss insists, it’s worth the effort. Option 3: Politely Decline. Sometimes, a simple, in-person explanation works best. Say something like, 'I keep my Facebook for close friends, but I’d love to connect on LinkedIn!' Deliver it casually—never via message. People usually respond better to tone than text. Option 4: Clean Up Your Profile. The best long-term fix? Stop posting anything you wouldn’t want your aunt, boss, or neighbor to see. Even 'friends-only' albums aren’t foolproof. Recruiters, coworkers, and curious relatives have found far worse than you think. Assume everything is public. Always.
translated_content: एक वर्षभन्दा बढी देखि हामीले फेसबुकको नेटिकेट बारे प्रश्नहरूको उत्तर दिँदै आएका छौं— र एउटा समस्या बारम्बार उठ्दै आइरहेको छ: तपाईंको आमा, बोस, वा बुढा पडोसीले तपाईंलाई फेसबुकमा मित्र बनाउने अनुरोध गर्दा तपाईंले स्वीकार गर्न नचाहनु भएको हो भने के गर्ने? यो वास्तविक समस्या हो: तपाईंले आफ्नो पार्टीको फोटो वा ११ वर्षको बच्चाजस्तो देखिने भन्ने चिन्ता गर्नुहुन्छ, तर तपाईंले अनुरोध खारेज गर्नुभएको देखिएको भए उनीहरूले नोटिस गर्न सक्छन्—खासगरी यदि उनीहरू त्यस्ता मानिसहरू हुन् जसले सबै कुरा नोटिस गर्छन्। यहाँ तपाईंको अनचाहेका फेसबुक मित्र अनुरोधहरू सँग सम्बोधन गर्ने चार व्यावहारिक विकल्पहरू: विकल्प १: अनदेखा गर्नुहोस्। फेसबुकले तपाईंलाई अनुरोधलाई स्पष्ट रूपमा खारेज नगरी निस्कन दिन्छ। 'अहिले नहोस्' क्लिक गर्नुहोस्। अनुरोध गर्ने व्यक्तिलाई केही थाहा हुँदैन, र उनीहरूले तपाईं फेसबुकमा सक्रिय छैनौं भन्ने अनुमान गर्न सक्छन्। यो निष्क्रिय तर प्रभावकारी छ। विकल्प २: स्वीकार गर्नुहोस्—तर सीमित गरी। यदि तपाईंले स्वीकार गर्नुपर्छ भने, उनीहरूले के हेर्न सक्छन् भन्ने कुरा सीमित गर्न फेसबुकको गोपनीयता साधनहरू प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। 'सीमित प्रोफाइल' वा 'कामका सम्पर्कहरू' नामको कस्टम सूची बनाउनुहोस्। त्यसपछि 'गोपनीयता सेटिङ्स > तपाईंको सम्पर्क' मा जाएर आफ्नो टाइमलाइनमा अरूले गरेका पोस्टहरू कसले हेर्न सक्छन् भन्ने कुरा समायोजन गर्नुहोस्। तपाईंले फोटो अल्बमहरूको दृश्यता पनि अलग रूपमा सीमित गर्नुपर्छ। यो जटिल छ, तर यदि तपाईंको बोसले अनुरोध गर्छ भने यो प्रयास गर्न मूल्यवान हुन सक्छ। विकल्प ३: विनम्रतापूर्वक खारेज गर्नुहोस्। कहिलेकाहीँ, एउटा सरल, व्यक्तिगत व्याख्या नै समाधान हुन्छ। भन्नुहोस्, 'मेरो फेसबुक करिबी मित्रहरूको लागि छ, तर म तपाईंलाई लिंक्डइनमा जोड्न चाहन्छु!' यो कुरा व्यक्तिगत रूपमा बोल्नुहोस्—फेसबुक सन्देश वा ईमेलबाट होइन। मानिसहरूले टेक्स्टभन्दा टोनलाई बढी स्वीकार गर्छन्। विकल्प ४: आफ्नो प्रोफाइल सफा गर्नुहोस्। सबैभन्दा राम्रो दीर्घकालीन समाधान? तपाईंले आफ्नो आमा, बोस, वा पडोसीले हेर्न नचाहेको कुरा कहिल्यै पनि फेसबुकमा पोस्ट नगर्नुहोस्। यहाँ सम्म 'मित्रहरू मात्र' सेटिङ्ग पनि असुरक्षित हुन सक्छ। रिक्रूटरहरू, सहकर्मीहरू, र जिज्ञासु पडोसीहरूले तपाईं भन्दा धेरै बिग्रिएको कुरा पनि पाएका छन्। सबै कुरा सार्वजनिक भएको मान्नुहोस्। हमेशा।

article_content: Los Angeles (CNN) — U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) agents in Los Angeles seized 20,457 pairs of counterfeit Christian Louboutin shoes shipped from China, officials said Thursday. The fake shoes, featuring the brand’s iconic lacquered red soles — a hallmark of women’s fashion — could have fetched $18 million if sold through illicit online and underground markets, according to CBP. Five shipments were intercepted at the Los Angeles/Long Beach seaport on July 27 and August 14, CBP said in a release. 'CBP maintains an aggressive and proactive posture on intercepting shipments containing counterfeit and pirated goods,' said Todd C. Owen, Director of Field Operations in Los Angeles. 'Counterfeit luxury items, often sold on illegitimate websites and underground outlets, fuel the illegal profits of smugglers and traffickers,' the agency added. 'Consumers are misled into believing they are purchasing authentic products at a significant discount.' Separate reports note that Christian Louboutin has revealed the science behind its signature high heel design, and Beyoncé wore red footwear at her first post-baby public appearance — though these are unrelated to the seizure.

article_content: If Scotland votes for independence, Alex Salmond and the Scottish National Party are calling for a full transfer of £10 billion worth of UK military assets—including ships, planes, and nearly 9,200 service members—to help build a new Scottish defense force. Their plan includes taking two Type 23 frigates like HMS Argyll, several patrol vessels, up to 12 Typhoon fighter jets, transport aircraft, and multiple infantry battalions with strong Scottish ties, such as the Black Watch and Royal Highland Fusiliers. They also seek around 2,000 sailors, 2,000 airmen, and 3,500 soldiers, along with support units in logistics, communications, and medical services—all to be transferred without cost. The SNP argues this would allow Scotland to establish a credible navy, air force, and army by 2016, funded by an annual budget of £2.5 billion. However, UK defense analysts question whether this budget can realistically support such ambitions, especially given the goal of expanding to 15,000 personnel over a decade. Experts warn that losing these assets would degrade the UK’s operational capacity, particularly for the Royal Navy, already operating with its smallest fleet in centuries. Beyond conventional forces, the plan raises serious concerns about intelligence. An independent Scotland would immediately lose access to MI5, MI6, GCHQ, and the Five Eyes intelligence network—the global alliance including the US, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Instead, Scotland would start with an estimated 720 intelligence officers, lacking access to critical data-sharing systems and facing suspicion from allies due to past political decisions, such as the release of the Lockerbie bomber. Former UK defense leaders, including ex-First Sea Lord Lord West, argue that the separation would leave both nations less safe. They point out that UK-based intelligence and military personnel are bound by contracts to the UK government—not Scotland—and may not transfer. Additionally, experts fear that without robust monitoring, returning jihadists from conflict zones could slip through gaps in Scotland’s nascent security apparatus, increasing risks for the entire region. Professor Malcolm Chambers of the Royal United Services Institute notes that building full military capability overnight is impossible. Even if personnel choose to move, infrastructure, training pipelines, and command systems take years to develop. Meanwhile, the UK Ministry of Defence maintains that Scotland is safer within the Union, benefiting from shared resources, bases, and collective defense.

article_content: By Bianca London. PUBLISHED: 11:09 EST, 13 March 2014. | UPDATED: 11:56 EST, 13 March 2014. From Botox and lasers to Kim Kardashian’s favorite vampire facelifts, it seems we have entered a new era in the fight against wrinkles. But the latest addition to the growing list of unusual skincare treatments may truly be described as out of this world. Renowned Harley Street plastic surgeon Dr. Yannis Alexandrides has developed a range of skincare products—called 111SKIN—in collaboration with two former scientists from the Soviet Space Program, who contributed to major breakthroughs in spaceflight over six decades. Galactic skincare: The 111SKIN line claims to help maintain youthful skin. Its formulations were originally developed after astronauts reported skin issues such as thinning, dryness, increased sensitivity, and delayed healing during space missions. After the Soviet space program ended, the scientists retained their patented formula—NAC Y²—which combines NAC, Vitamin C, and Escin. This blend boosts Glutathione, the body’s most vital cellular antioxidant, which naturally declines with age. NAC and Vitamin C are essential for stimulating Glutathione production, while Escin acts as a potent antioxidant that enhances blood circulation, promotes collagen synthesis, and aids the delivery of NAC and Vitamin C directly to skin cells. Together, these ingredients claim to detoxify, hydrate, and regenerate skin from within, strengthening its barrier and fighting environmental damage. Each 111SKIN product—sold at Harrods and priced between £40 and £190—contains the patented NAC Y² formula. This antioxidant complex has been used by astronauts in supplement form for over 25 years and is supported by NASA research for its ability to delay aging and activate the body’s natural repair systems. One standout product, the £117 Space Anti-Age NAC Y² Facelift Day Cream, claims to heal skin while reducing scarring. Another hero product is the 111SKIN Celestial Black Diamond Cream—a luxurious anti-aging treatment infused with rare diamond dust particles. At £599 for 50ml, it’s one of the most expensive skincare products on the market. The Celestial Black Diamond Cream claims to penetrate deep skin layers to deliver youth-restoring ingredients—including the NAC Y² formula, Collagen Types I and III, and Hyaluronic Acid. Though marketed as ‘space-derived,’ the diamond particles are not from outer space but are synthetic, engineered to mimic cosmic properties.

त्वचालाई विषहरूबाट मुक्त गर्ने, आर्द्र राख्ने र कोशिकाहरूलाई पुनर्जन्म दिने दाबी गर्छ, जसले त्वचालाई भित्रबाट मजबूत बनाउँछ र क्षति विरुद्ध लड्छ। १११एसकिन प्रत्येक उत्पादन—जुन हार्रोड्समा बिक्री हुन्छ article_content: In late 2012, former CIA Director General David Petraeus resigned after it was revealed he had an extramarital relationship with Paula Broadwell, a military historian and author writing his biography. The affair became public when the FBI, investigating threatening emails Broadwell sent to Jill Kelley — a friend of the Petraeus family — discovered unauthorized access to Petraeus’s private email accounts. These investigations uncovered highly personal messages, including references to private moments. Although the White House stated that President Obama learned of the affair only on November 9, 2012 — the same day Petraeus resigned, one day after Obama’s re-election — many questioned how a major security breach involving a top intelligence official remained undisclosed for months. Critics speculated the timing of the resignation, which occurred just before Petraeus was set to testify before Congress regarding the 2012 Benghazi attack, was politically advantageous. Broadwell, a married mother of two, met Petraeus in Afghanistan in 2010 while conducting research for her book, 'All In: The Education of General David Petraeus.' She described their connection as rooted in shared commitment and physical endurance during fieldwork. While no proof confirms the administration intentionally concealed the scandal to protect the president’s campaign, the prolonged silence has raised legitimate concerns about whether institutional norms were sacrificed for political expediency.

article_content: In the wake of the deadly January 2015 attacks on Charlie Hebdo, over a million people gathered in Paris for the historic Marche Républicaine — a powerful demonstration of global unity against terrorism. Leaders from across Europe, Africa, and the Middle East walked arm-in-arm, including political rivals like Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Mahmoud Abbas, as well as Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov and Ukrainian President Petro Poroshenko. The sight of these figures standing together sent a profound message: even in times of deep division, humanity can unite against violence. Yet amid this unprecedented display of solidarity, the United States was conspicuously absent. President Barack Obama, who had publicly declared France as America’s ‘oldest ally,’ remained in Washington. So too did Vice President Joe Biden, whose schedule was clear. Secretary of State John Kerry was in India on a pre-scheduled trip. The highest-ranking U.S. official physically present in Paris was Ambassador Jane Hartley — a diplomat largely unknown to the American public. Attorney General Eric Holder, a cabinet-level official, did attend Paris — but not the march. Instead, he participated in a parallel counterterrorism summit and then disappeared from public view to appear on four major U.S. morning talk shows. DHS Deputy Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas also skipped the procession. While the White House insisted Holder’s presence at the summit constituted official representation, critics questioned why no senior leader chose to walk beside the world’s leaders in a moment demanding visible, symbolic commitment. The silence from the White House on whether Obama had spent his Sunday afternoon watching NFL games only fueled the backlash. Prominent voices like Newt Gingrich, Greta Van Susteren, and CNN’s Jake Tapper voiced disappointment. Former Speaker Gingrich called it ‘sad’ that 50 world leaders showed up while the U.S. president did not. Analysts like Fareed Zakaria and Forbes’ Stuart Anderson argued that Obama missed a pivotal chance to affirm America’s values and leadership on the global stage. In response, the White House pointed to President Obama’s earlier visit to the French Embassy in Washington, where he signed a condolence book with the words ‘Vive la France!’ and his phone call to President Hollande. They emphasized that the U.S. was engaged through diplomacy and would soon host a major summit on countering violent extremism — a practical step, they claimed, rather than a symbolic one. But symbolism matters. In moments of collective grief and resolve, presence speaks louder than policy. The images of leaders from nations with bitter rivalries walking shoulder to shoulder in Paris became iconic. The absence of the world’s most powerful nation’s leader, however, lingered as a quiet but potent question: When the world calls for unity, who is truly standing with us?
translated_content: चार्ली हेब्डोको आतंकवादी हमलाका पछि, पेरिसमा ऐतिहासिक मार्च रिपब्लिकेनमा अधिक एक दशलाख मानिसहरू सङ्ग्रह भएका थिए — आतंकवादका विरुद्ध विश्वव्यापी एकताको शक्तिशाली प्रदर्शन। यसमा युरोप, अफ्रिका र मध्य पूर्वबाट नेताहरूले आपसी राजनीतिक शत्रुताका बावजूद आफ्ना हातहरू जोडेर चल्नुभयो, जस्तै इजरायली प्रधानमन्त्री बेन्जामिन नेतन्याहु र फिलिस्तिनी नेता महमूद अब्बास, साथै रूसी विदेश मन्त्री सर्गेई लाभ्रोभ र उक्रेनी राष्ट्रपति पिट्रो पोरोशेन्को। यी नेताहरूको साथमा चल्ने दृश्यले गहिरो सन्देश पठाएको थियो: गहिरो विभाजनको समयमा पनि मानवता आतंकवादका विरुद्ध एकजुट हुन सक्छ। तर यो अभूतपूर्व एकताको प्रदर्शनको बीचमा संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका अदृश्य थियो। राष्ट्रपति बराक ओबामा, जसले फ्रान्सलाई अमेरिकाको ‘पुरानो साझेदार’ भनेर घोषणा गरिसकेका थिए, वाशिङ्टनमै रहनुभयो। उही वाइस प्रेसिडेन्ट जो बाइडेन पनि, जसको कार्यक्रम खाली थियो, उपस्थित भएनन्। राष्ट्रिय विदेश मन्त्री जॉन केरी भारतमा अगाडि निर्धारित यात्रामा थिए। पेरिसमा उपस्थित भएको अमेरिकीको उच्चतम पदस्थ अधिकारी अमेरिकी राजदूत जेन हार्टले थिए — जसलाई अमेरिकी जनतामा धेरैले पहिचान गर्दैनन्। क्याबिनेट स्तरका अधिकारी एटर्नी जनरल एरिक होल्डरले पेरिसमा आउनुभयो — तर मार्चमा भएन। उहाँले एक अलग आतंकवाद विरुद्ध सुरक्षा शिखर सम्मेलनमा भाग लिनुभयो र त्यसपछि चार ठूला अमेरिकी सुबहका टेलिभिजन कार्यक्रममा देखा पर्नुभयो। DHS उप मन्त्री अलेजान्द्रो मायोर्कास पनि मार्चबाट टाढा रहनुभयो। व्हाइट हाउसले भन्यो कि होल्डरको सुरक्षा सम्मेलनमा उपस्थिति नै अमेरिकाको औपचारिक प्रतिनिधित्व हो, तर आलोचकहरूले प्रश्न उठाए: यो समयमा विश्वका नेताहरूको साथमा चल्ने अवसरमा किन कुनै उच्च पदस्थ अधिकारीले यो दृश्यात्मक प्रतिबद्धता देखाउन सक्दैन? ओबामाले रविबारको दिन एनएफएल खेल हेर्दै बिताएका थिए भन्ने शंकाले आलोचना बढायो। न्यूट गिङ्ग्रिच, ग्रेटा भ्यान सुस्टरेन र सीएनएनका जेक ट्यापर जस्ता प्रमुख आवाजहरूले निराशा व्यक्त गरे। अघिल्लो स्पीकर गिङ्ग्रिचले भने, ‘50 वटा विश्व नेताहरूले आउनुभयो, तर अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति आउनुभएन भन्ने कुरा दुःखद छ।’ विश्लेषकहरू जस्तै फेरिड जाकारिया र फोर्ब्सका स्टुअर्ट एन्डरसनले भने कि ओबामाले अमेरिकाको मूल्य र विश्वव्यापी नेतृत्व प्रमाणित गर्ने एक महत्वपूर्ण अवसर गुमाएका थिए। प्रतिक्रियामा व्हाइट हाउसले राष्ट्रपति ओबामाको वाशिङ्टनमा फ्रान्सीसी दूतावासमा जानु र ‘वाइभ ला फ्रान्स!’ भन्ने शब्दहरू लेख्नुभएको र राष्ट्रपति होल्डरलाई फोन गर्नुभएको उल्लेख गर्यो। उहाँहरूले भने कि अमेरिका राजनीतिक रूपमा संलग्न छ र आगामी फेब्रुअरीमा आतंकवाद विरुद्धको शिखर सम्मेलन आयोजना गर्ने छ — जुन औपचारिक कदम हो, तर प्रतीकात्मक कदम होइन। तर प्रतीकहरू महत्वपूर्ण छन्। सामूहिक शोक र दृढताको समयमा, उपस्थिति नीतिभन्दा बढी कुरु भन्छ। पेरिसमा शत्रु राष्ट्रहरूका नेताहरूले कतै दाँडामा चल्ने दृश्य ऐतिहासिक भयो। तर विश्वको सबैभन्दा शक्तिशाली राष्ट्रका नेताको अनुपस्थिति एउटा चुपचाप र शक्तिशाली प्रश्न बन्यो: जब विश्वले एकताको आह्वान गर्छ, तब को वास्तविक रूपमा हाम्रो साथमा छ?

article_content: With a past association with former Manchester United manager Ryan Giggs, along with a stint on Big Brother and numerous lingerie shoots, Imogen Thomas became one of the most prominent glamour models of the decade. But the Welsh beauty queen and former reality TV star says she has 'hung up' her lingerie to focus on motherhood. Speaking to MailOnline, the mother of one said: 'I used to be desperate for magazine shoots—I really enjoyed it. While I still get offers, now that I'm 31, it's time to hang up the lingerie.' Imogen, who gave birth to her first child, Ariana, with Australian boyfriend Adam Horsley in February 2023, says that although she had a 'good run,' she is enjoying motherhood so much that she’s letting younger women take over lingerie modeling. One challenge of becoming a new mother was gaining weight—something she found difficult to lose. 'I was snacking on Ariana’s food when we ate out. She’d have two chips, and I’d eat the rest. As all new mothers know, it’s hard to shed pounds, especially stubborn belly fat,' she said. After gaining weight and going up to a size 12, Imogen has returned to a size 10 through healthy eating, regular exercise, and taking Nature’s Way African Mango seed extract, which claims to inhibit fat cell growth and promote fat breakdown. 'It helps curb my snacking and gives me energy in the morning. I also love trampolining—it’s great for weight loss. I go to spin class, and even though I sometimes dread it, I always feel better afterward,' she added. Imogen credits her lack of stretch marks to an obsession with skincare: she scrubs her skin for 20 minutes daily. Thanks to her new fitness and beauty routine, she now feels body confident. 'I want to feel good on the poolside this summer—and I definitely feel bikini-ready now. I can’t wait to show off the results on my next holiday,' she said. Her diet doesn’t involve deprivation. 'I love sweet potatoes, but I also enjoy the occasional strawberry dipped in dark chocolate. I don’t know how people can cut out treats entirely.' In addition to her health journey, Imogen has paused her professional projects to spend time with family and redecorate their home. article_content: An Alabama man known as a jihadist 'rock star,' two women from Minnesota, and a California man are among 14 individuals charged by the U.S. Justice Department for aiding Al-Shabaab, an al Qaeda-linked militant group in Somalia. The indictments, unsealed Thursday, accuse the suspects of providing money, personnel, and services to the insurgency. Most of those charged are believed to be fighting in Somalia, while others are accused of fundraising in the U.S., particularly within Minnesota’s large Somali immigrant community. FBI agents arrested two women in Rochester, Minnesota — Amina Farah Ali, 33, and Hawo Mohamed Hassan, 63 — on charges of collecting funds under false pretenses, claiming the money would help the poor and needy. Attorney General Eric Holder warned that supporting terrorist groups carries severe consequences: 'If you choose this route, you can expect to find yourself in a U.S. jail cell or a casualty on the battlefield in Somalia.' Two U.S. citizens, Omar Shafik Hammami, 26, from Alabama, and Jehad Serwan Mostafa, 28, from California, are accused of providing material support to Al-Shabaab and are believed to be actively fighting with the group. Hammami, once raised as a Baptist, converted to Islam and gained attention through rap-style videos blending American and Somali culture. In one video, he declares, 'Mortar by mortar, shell by shell, only going to stop when I send them to hell.' Analyst Frank Cilluffo noted that Hammami’s messaging resonates with some American youth because it reflects familiar cultural elements, making radicalization more relatable. Separate charges were filed against 10 other men from Minnesota, several of whom had prior legal issues. Five are accused of conspiring to kill, maim, or injure people abroad, while others face charges related to firearms and solicitation of violent crimes. All five had been previously charged in connection with Al-Shabaab. Meanwhile, in Chicago, 26-year-old U.S. citizen Shaker Masri was arrested for allegedly attempting to use a weapon of mass destruction abroad, violating federal law. Minnesota remains home to the nation’s largest Somali population, with tens of thousands of residents having migrated there as refugees since the 1990s. Holder emphasized that innocent Muslims have suffered greatly at the hands of Al-Shabaab and other extremist groups, and commended American Muslim leaders for actively countering radicalization. He highlighted recent public campaigns by prominent American Muslims condemning online recruitment tactics used by extremists.
translated_content: एक अलाबामा पुरुष जसलाई जिहादी 'रक स्टार' भनिन्छ, मिनेसोटाकी दुई महिलाहरू र क्यालिफोर्नियाको एक पुरुष विशेषगरी अल-शबाबको समर्थन गर्ने आरोपमा १४ जनामध्ये हुन्। जस्टिस डिपार्टमेन्टले बुधबार यी १४ जनाको खुला आरोप जारी गर्यो, जसले आतंकवादी समूहलाई धन, कर्मचारी र सेवाहरू प्रदान गर्ने आरोप लगाएको छ। आरोपितहरूमध्ये धेरै अफ्रिकाको सोमालियामा विद्रोहीहरूको साथमा लड्दै गरेको विश्वास गरिएको छ, जबकि अरू संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकामा, विशेषगरी मिनेसोटाको ठूलो सोमाली बस्तीमा धन संकलन गर्ने आरोपमा छन्। एफबीआईले मिनेसोटाको रोचेस्टरमा दुई महिलाहरू — अमिना फराह अली (३३) र हावो मोहम्मद हसान (६३) — लाई आरोपित गरिएको छ कि उनीहरूले गरिब र आवश्यकता भएकाहरूलाई सहयोग गर्ने झूटो बहाना बनाएर सोमालियाका विद्रोहीहरूको लागि धन संकलन गरेका छन्। न्यायमूर्ति एरिक होल्डरले चेतावनी दिएका छन् कि आतंकवादी समूहहरूलाई समर्थन गर्नु भनेको गम्भीर परिणामको सामना गर्नुपर्ने हुन्छ: 'यदि तपाईंले यो बाटो अपनाउनुभयो भने, तपाईंले संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाको जेलको कोठामा वा सोमालियाको युद्धक्षेत्रमा शहीद भएको देख्नुहुनेछ।' दुई संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाका नागरिक, अलाबामाका ओमार शाफिक हम्मामी (२६) र क्यालिफोर्नियाका जेहाद सर्वान मोस्ताफा (२८) लाई अल-शबाबलाई सामग्री समर्थन प्रदान गर्ने आरोप लगाइएको छ र उनीहरू सोमालियामा विद्रोहीहरूको साथमा लड्दै गरेको विश्वास गरिएको छ। हम्मामी, जसलाई बप्तिस्मा धर्ममा ठाडो गरिएको थियो, युवाकालमा इस्लाममा परिवर्तन गरेर अमेरिकी र सोमाली संस्कृतिलाई जोड्ने र्याप शैलीका भिडियोहरूबाट ध्यान आकर्षित गरेका छन्। एउटा भिडियोमा उनले घोषणा गर्छन्, 'मर्टार देखि मर्टार, शेल देखि शेल, जबसम्म म तिनीहरूलाई नराखेँ।' विश्लेषक फ्राङ्क सिलुफोले नोट गर्छन् कि हम्मामीको सन्देश केही अमेरिकी युवाहरूलाई सम्बोधन गर्छ किनभने यसले परिचित सांस्कृतिक तत्वहरू प्रतिबिम्बित गर्छ, जसले आतंकवादी अपहरणलाई अझ बढी सम्बन्धित बनाउँछ। मिनेसोटाका १० जना पुरुषहरूको विरुद्ध अलग आरोप लगाइएको छ, जसमध्ये केहीले पहिले नै कानूनी समस्याहरू भएका थिए। पाँचजनालाई विदेशमा मानिसहरूलाई मार्ने, घाइते पार्ने वा चोट पार्ने षड्यन्त्र गर्ने र आतंकवादी समर्थन प्रदान गर्ने आरोप लगाइएको छ, जबकि अरू आतंकवादी अपराधमा हतियार राख्ने र अपराधको लागि उत्तेजना गर्ने आरोपमा छन्। यी पाँच जनालाई पहिले नै अल-शबाबसँग सम्बन्धित आरोपमा चार्ज गरिएको थियो। त्यसैगरी, चिकागोमा २६ वर्षीय संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाका नागरिक शेकर मास्रीलाई विदेशमा भएको अपराधमा भएको जनसंख्या विनाशको हतियार प्रयोग गर्ने प्रयास गर्ने आरोपमा गिरफ्तार गरिएको छ। मिनेसोटा संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाको सबैभन्दा ठूलो सोमाली बस्ती हो, जहाँ १९९० को दशकदेखि लाखौं शरणार्थीहरू आएका छन्। होल्डरले अल-शबाब र अन्य चरमपन्थी समूहहरूको आक्रमणबाट निर्दोष मुस्लिमहरू धेरै बलिएको उल्लेख गर्दै अमेरिकी मुस्लिम नेताहरूलाई आतंकवादी अपहरणलाई रोक्ने प्रयासको लागि प्रशंसा गर्नुभएको छ। उनले अहिले सम्म अमेरिकी मुस्लिमहरूले इन्टरनेटमार्फत युवाहरूलाई आकर्षित गर्ने चरमपन्थीहरूको ताकत विरुद्ध विडियो बनाएर विरोध जनाएको उल्लेख गर्नुभएको छ।

article_content: Every day, Sportsmail reviews European sports papers to highlight the biggest stories sparking debate across the continent. In Madrid, the top headlines belong to James Rodríguez, the World Cup Golden Boot winner, as Real Madrid pushes to sign the Colombian star. Marca reports that Monaco is seeking an additional €10 million, raising the total transfer fee from €75m to €85m — though Rodríguez is already searching for a home in the city. AS is confident Rodríguez will thrive at Real, stating he’s ‘ready’ and even has a locker reserved at the club’s Valdebebas training base. Both papers note that Rodríguez is expected to meet with Monaco on Monday — likely to say goodbye. AS adds that the official transfer will be finalized once Ángel Di María departs the Bernabéu. Meanwhile, Álvaro Morata has already left Real Madrid for Juventus. Marca suggests Real will operate ‘without a No. 9,’ while former striker Cristiano Ronaldo congratulated the club on signing ‘the best player from the World Cup’ — James Rodríguez. Across town, AS reports that Atlético Madrid is targeting major additions ahead of their pre-season tour, with names like Italy’s Alessio Cerci (Torino) and Benfica’s Nicolás Gaitán being floated. Both papers feature photos of Barcelona’s new head coach Luis Enrique and goalkeeper Marc-André ter Stegen during training. Sport leads with a rumored battle between Bayern Munich and Barcelona for Colombia’s Juan Cuadrado, with Fiorentina demanding €42 million. In Italy, the headline is Juventus’s signing of Roberto Pereyra from Udinese. The midfielder joins on Monday, though his future at the club remains uncertain — especially with Arturo Vidal possibly departing. article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) — A massive fire engulfed the four-story office building of major film company Future Films in central London on Friday, sending plumes of white smoke across the city skyline, according to the London Fire Brigade. Streets in the area were cordoned off as firefighters battled the blaze. Two firefighters were taken to hospital with minor injuries after responding to the incident at the Future Films building on Dean Street in London’s Soho district, London Ambulance Service confirmed. The London Fire Brigade deployed 12 fire engines and 55 firefighters to combat the fire, which began before 2 p.m. local time (9 a.m. ET). As a result, adjacent streets—including W1—were closed to both traffic and pedestrians. When contacted by CNN, Future Films founder and managing director Stephen Margolis declined to comment on the incident. Since its founding by Margolis in 2000, Future Films has produced more than 120 films, including 'Bend It Like Beckham' (2002), 'The Importance of Being Earnest' (2002), and 'Transsiberian' (2008). CNN’s Per Nyberg and Laura Perez Maestro contributed to this report.

article_content: This month, China is preparing for a major leap in its space ambitions: launching its first crewed mission to dock with the Tiangong-1 space laboratory. According to official reports, the Shenzhou-9 spacecraft, carried by the Long March-2F rocket, has been transported to a launch facility in Gansu Province for final preparations. If successful, China will join the United States and Russia as only the third nation to perform a manned orbital docking — a milestone that underscores its growing capabilities in human spaceflight. While the exact crew composition remains under review, officials have indicated that a woman might be included among the three astronauts selected for the mission. One crew member will stay aboard the spacecraft during docking as a safety measure, a standard protocol in case of emergencies. The Tiangong-1 module, launched in September 2011, previously achieved an automated docking with the uncrewed Shenzhou-8 spacecraft last November, proving China’s technical readiness for more complex operations. China’s long-term goals extend far beyond this mission — officials have publicly stated ambitions to construct a domestically operated space station similar to the ISS and ultimately send astronauts to the Moon. Analysts like Taylor Fravel from MIT note that these achievements reflect China’s determination to become a leading, self-reliant space power. Meanwhile, China is also expanding international partnerships, signing a space cooperation deal with Pakistan through 2020 during Pakistani President Asif Ali Zardari’s visit to Beijing. As China accelerates its lunar ambitions, the U.S. is pivoting toward deep-space missions, and private enterprises such as SpaceX are reshaping the industry — recently completing the first commercial resupply mission to the ISS with its Dragon capsule. While global space competition intensifies, China’s steady progress signals a new era in human space exploration.

article_content: On October 12, 2013, a boat carrying over 250 migrants fleeing Syria’s civil war capsized near the Italian island of Lampedusa, killing at least 34 people — including six children and one newborn. Among the survivors were a Syrian mother and father who managed to save their nine-month-old daughter by keeping her above water, but lost their three-year-old son, who could no longer hold on. The vessel sank after passengers rushed to one side in an attempt to attract the attention of a passing helicopter. Lampedusa, located midway between Sicily and Tunisia, is a frequent destination for smugglers who charge over £850 per person to transport migrants in dangerously overcrowded vessels. Rescue efforts by Maltese and Italian forces recovered survivors and transported bodies to shore. Images showed grieving families, coffins being loaded onto naval ships, and children being carried to safety. Michele Prosperi of Save the Children Italy described the parents’ ordeal: 'They stayed in the water for over an hour, holding their daughter aloft while their son slipped away.' The disaster occurred just over a week after another tragedy claimed more than 300 African migrants in the same waters. Malta’s Prime Minister, Joseph Muscat, condemned the ongoing crisis, stating, 'As things stand, we are just building a cemetery within our Mediterranean Sea.' More than 50 survivors, including 15 minors, were transferred to Sicily aboard an Italian frigate. Many are now receiving care at a reception center on Lampedusa, while others mourn lost loved ones beside the coffins of their children.
translated_content: २०१३ को अक्टोबर १२ मा, सिरियाक गृहयुद्धबाट भाग्ने २५० भन्दा बढी शरणार्थीहरूलाई ल्याम्पेडुसाको नजिकै एउटा नाव डुबेको थियो, जसले कम्तिमा ३४ जनाको ज्यान लियो — जसमध्ये छ बच्चाहरू र एउटा नवजात बच्चा। बच्ने समूहमध्ये एक आमा र बाबु थिए जसले आफ्नो नौ महिनाको छोरीलाई पानीबाहिर बाँचाउन सफल भए, तर आफ्नो तीन वर्षको छोरालाई हराए, जसले अब बच्न सकेन। यो नाव एउटा हेलिकप्टरलाई ध्यान दिन यात्रीहरूले एक तिर भिडिएपछि डुबेको थियो। सिसिली र ट्यूनिसियाको बीचमा अवस्थित ल्याम्पेडुसा एक ठूलो गन्तव्य हो जहाँ गैरकानूनी आपूर्तिकर्ताहरू प्रति व्यक्ति £८५० भन्दा बढी शुल्क लिएर अत्यधिक भरिएका नावहरूमा शरणार्थीहरू लैजान्छन्। माल्टा र इटालीका बचाव दलहरूले बच्ने र मृतकहरूलाई तटमा पुर्याए। चित्रहरूले शोकग्रस्त परिवारहरू, नौसैनिक जहाजमा लादिने लाशहरू, र बच्चाहरूलाई बचाउँदै लैजाने दृश्यहरू देखाए। सेभ द चिल्ड्रेन इटालीका मिकेल प्रोस्पेरीले आमाबाबुको दुःख यसरी वर्णन गरे: 'उनीहरू पानीमा एक घण्टाभन्दा बढी समय बिताए, आफ्नी छोरीलाई उठाएर बचाए तर आफ्नो छोरालाई खोइदिए।' यो दुर्घटना अहिले भएको एउटा अर्को दुर्घटनापछि भएको थियो जसले त्यही क्षेत्रमा ३०० भन्दा बढी अफ्रिकी शरणार्थीहरूको ज्यान लिएको थियो। माल्टाका प्रधानमन्त्री जोसेफ मुस्काटले यो निरन्तर संकटलाई निन्दा गर्दै भने, 'अहिले अवस्था अनुसार, हामी मिडिटेरेनियन सागरभित्र नै कब्रिस्तान बनाइरहेका छौं।' ५० भन्दा बढी बच्ने व्यक्तिहरू, जसमध्ये १५ बच्चाहरू समावेश छन्, इटालीय फ्रिगेटमा सिसिलीको ओर तिर लैजाइएका छन्। धेरै जना अहिले ल्याम्पेडुसामा एउटा स्वीकृति केन्द्रमा स्वास्थ्य सेवा पाइरहेका छन्, जबकि अरूहरू आफ्ना बच्चाहरूका लाशहरूको पार्श्वमा शोक गरिरहेका छन्।

article_content: Parents of a four-month-old boy from Knoxville, Iowa, have been charged with neglect and child endangerment after their infant was hospitalized with severe, non-accidental injuries. Authorities reported the baby suffered 14 fractured ribs, a dislocated hip, a fractured wrist, and a fractured femur. The child was brought to the hospital on July 17, 2013. Investigators determined the injuries did not align with the explanations provided by the parents, prompting intervention by the Department of Human Services and a police investigation. On September 23, 2013, Clayton John Fischer, 24, and his wife, Hollie May Fischer, 21, turned themselves in after an arrest warrant was issued. They face one count of neglect of a dependent person and four counts of child endangerment causing serious bodily injury. Their son is no longer in their care and remains under state supervision while the investigation continues. The couple married in April 2012 and welcomed their first child in March 2013. Prior to the incident, Clayton Fischer had been arrested in January 2013 for public intoxication. On his first wedding anniversary, he posted a heartfelt message on Facebook: 'Well, a year ago, in about three hours, I married my best friend, my heart, my life, and the wonderful mother to my crabby child. They say the first year is the hardest, but it has brought me more joy and happiness than I ever expected. I look forward to many more years to come. I love ya, babe.'

article_content: In-form centre Jonathan Joseph has renewed his contract with Bath. The 23-year-old has scored seven tries in 15 games this season, and his performances earned him a call-up from England coach Stuart Lancaster as injury cover ahead of the QBE Autumn Internationals. Although Joseph did not play in any of those matches, he has earned six England caps since making his international debut against South Africa in 2012. A Bath statement did not disclose terms of the new contract, but the Derby-born back, who joined Bath from London Irish in 2013, said: 'I feel I've really developed as a player since joining Bath. With the help of the great coaches here, I've added more elements to my skillset, so I definitely wanted to stay.' Joseph cleared his lines during Bath’s 39–26 victory over Wasps on Saturday. He made his international debut against South Africa at Ellis Park in the summer of 2012. Head coach Mike Ford added: 'JJ is an incredibly talented young player who is on the brink of breaking into the England squad—and deserves it. He's been in fantastic form for us, providing a real threat in our backline, and his defence is international class. He's matured significantly over the past year, and we're delighted he's staying.' Bath head coach Mike Ford was thrilled to retain Joseph, who has been in blistering form this season.

article_content: On Thursday afternoon, two young men in their early twenties were pulled unconscious from the surf near rocky outcrops at Palm Beach, located on Sydney’s Northern Beaches, roughly 40 kilometers north of the city center. Emergency responders arrived after witnesses reported the men had been pulled into the ocean. According to Kate MacDonald, President of the Palm Beach Surf Life Saving Club, it remains uncertain whether the men jumped in voluntarily or were caught off-guard by strong currents. 'All we know is neither could swim,' she said. The lifeguards swiftly reached them using inflatable rescue boats. Both men were semi-conscious, struggling to breathe, and appeared to be in critical condition. 'They were perilously close to death,' MacDonald added. One man was airlifted to a nearby hospital; the other may have been transported by ambulance. The rescuers, later commended by NSW Ambulance, acted with precision under pressure. The men, who appear to be of South Asian descent, are believed to be visitors to Australia. The incident comes on the heels of a separate tragedy at The Entrance North, where a man in his 60s was pronounced dead after being pulled from the water earlier that day. With New Year’s Day drawing large crowds—including many tourists and swimmers of varying ability—MacDonald urged beachgoers to always swim between the flagged areas. 'The ocean doesn’t care who you are,' she warned. 'Lifesavers have the best eyes. And for parents, keep a tight watch on kids—they’ll dash straight into the water the moment it gets hot.'

article_content: Karen Orchard, a 40-year-old mother of two, is on trial at Truro Crown Court, accused of attempting to murder her ex-partner Geoffrey Richards and her former best friend Rosanna Vanhorn. Prosecutors allege that on January 21, 2012, Orchard deliberately drove her people carrier at the couple three times after spotting them walking hand in hand in the village of Lizard, west Cornwall. According to the prosecution, Orchard honked continuously while accelerating toward them, forcing Richards and Vanhorn to leap out of harm's way. On the second attempt, she mounted a pavement and struck a concrete bollard, which prevented direct impact. During the third attempt, her car struck a gate where Vanhorn was standing, pinning her beneath it momentarily before she was pulled to safety. After the incidents, police recovered a text message from Orchard’s phone that read: 'I have just tried to kill them.' She also insulted Vanhorn, calling her a 'f****** b***h' and accusing her of knowingly pursuing relationships with men already involved with others. Orchard claimed she was battling cancer and felt her life was over—except for her two daughters, whom she described as her only reason to live. Richards testified that the first encounter felt like an attempt to scare them, noting Orchard swerved away just meters before impact. However, the prosecution maintains the pattern of repeated, high-speed assaults shows clear intent to kill. Orchard denies all charges, including attempted murder and dangerous driving. Her defense contends she only honked her horn to get their attention and that the victims fled unnecessarily. The defense also challenged claims of serious injury, noting Vanhorn suffered only minor grazes and that the gate incident was misrepresented. Orchard, who walks with a cane due to a chronic ankle injury, reportedly cried and drank wine when police arrived at her home. In a written statement, she insisted she never intended to harm anyone and only wanted to speak to them. The trial continues.

article_content: In the golden age of Hollywood, cigarettes were more than a habit—they were symbols of glamour, rebellion, and raw sex appeal, worn by icons like Audrey Hepburn, James Dean, and Marlon Brando. But today, tobacco companies hoping e-cigarettes will inherit that allure are in for a surprise. Instead of heroes, filmmakers are turning these vaporizing devices into tools for portraying morally hollow villains. Actor Michael Shannon, known for his intense roles in films like 99 Homes, says his character’s e-cigarette wasn’t just a prop—it was essential. Director Ramin Bahrani gave him the device to signal a man who’s ‘too slick to be trusted.’ Shannon describes how he couldn’t stop fiddling with it: 'It was like one of those old cartoons with steam puffing from a smokestack—this guy was always about to blow.' The device became a narrative crutch during a pivotal scene where Shannon’s character, a ruthless real estate agent, confronts a desperate tenant threatening suicide. The e-cigarette’s constant hiss mirrored his inner tension—and his detachment. The Tourist, starring Johnny Depp and Angelina Jolie, was among the first mainstream films to feature e-cigarettes. In one scene, Depp’s character lights up on a train, explaining to authorities that e-cigarettes aren’t covered by public smoking bans—a clever plot device that also highlighted their legal gray area. Traditional cigarettes once defined female empowerment through stars like Bette Davis and Marlene Dietrich, and timeless style via Hepburn’s cigarette holder in Breakfast at Tiffany’s. But since the 1998 Master Settlement Agreement restricted tobacco product placement in films, smoking has dramatically declined on screen. Now, e-cigarettes are emerging—not as aspirational, but as unsettling signatures of modern villainy. Shannon predicts others will follow: 'Who knows? Probably. Other directors are going to copy it.'

article_content: Nobody who has seen David Adam Pate’s face is likely to forget it anytime soon. The 24-year-old South Carolina murder suspect posed for a disturbing mug shot after allegedly luring a friend into the woods, killing him, and leaving the body where neighborhood children could find it. In the photo, Pate appears to smile faintly while extending his surgically split tongue. At least a dozen tattoos are visible, including '974'—a known identifier of the Gangster Disciples street gang—on his neck; 'SATAN' above one eye; and a symbolic marking on his forehead. According to WBTV, detectives believe Pate led 33-year-old Ricky W. James into the woods near Lancaster, South Carolina, and murdered him in mid-October. He then covered the body with brush. Children playing in the area discovered James’ badly decomposed body last weekend. Pate was already in jail at the time—he had been arrested two weeks earlier on a disorderly conduct charge. Authorities immediately suspected him in the murder but waited for laboratory results before filing formal charges. He was officially charged with murder on Friday. Lancaster County Sheriff Barry Faile told WBTV, 'Our deepest condolences go out to the family of Mr. James. We are thankful that we were able to solve this case so quickly. Our investigators did a great job putting this case together. We suspected Pate almost immediately but had to wait on lab results to prove it. We are thankful he is in jail where he belongs.'

article_content: A former mayor of Kivumu, Rwanda, Gregoire Ndahimana, has been convicted of genocide and extermination as a crime against humanity for his role in the 1994 Rwandan genocide, the U.N.-backed International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR) announced on Thursday. As bourgmestre — or mayor — of Kivumu, Ndahimana was found to have actively facilitated the killings of thousands of Tutsis. The ICTR’s judgment highlights his presence during the massacre at Nyange Catholic Church, where approximately 2,000 Tutsi refugees were killed over ten days in April 1994. His presence, the tribunal concluded, had an encouraging effect on the perpetrators due to his position of authority. Although judges did not prove he personally ordered or supervised the attacks — including the bulldozing of the church — they determined he aided and abetted the genocide and bore command responsibility over local communal police. He was also convicted of extermination as a crime against humanity. Ndahimana, a trained agronomist, was sentenced to 15 years in prison. Two years of that sentence have already been served. The ICTR emphasized the extreme gravity of the crimes committed under his watch. In Kibuye prefecture alone, an estimated 59,050 people — 12.4% of the population — were killed during the genocide, representing more than three-quarters of its Tutsi community. The broader genocide, triggered by the assassination of Rwanda’s Hutu president on April 6, 1994, claimed around 800,000 lives across three months, carried out by an estimated 200,000 participants.

article_content: In a bold move to revive passenger rail travel, Mexico’s federal government has ordered private freight railway companies to give priority to passenger trains on their tracks—a first in decades. By January 15, the two dominant operators, CPKC and Ferromex, must submit concrete plans to launch passenger services. If they decline, the military—the army or navy—will step in, despite having zero experience running trains. Currently, nearly all Mexican rail traffic is freight-only, with only a handful of scenic tourist lines operating in places like the Copper Canyon and Jalisco’s tequila region. The government now wants to introduce four short-distance passenger routes and three ambitious long-haul corridors stretching from Mexico City to U.S. border towns: Nuevo Laredo (700 miles), Ciudad Juárez (900 miles), and Nogales (1,350 miles). The initiative reflects President López Obrador’s personal fondness for the passenger trains of the past and his increasing reliance on the armed forces for civilian infrastructure projects. Neither CPKC nor Ferromex will receive public subsidies under the plan, raising serious questions about financial viability. While CPKC says it’s open to collaboration—pointing to its experience managing passenger trains in North America—it insists freight operations must remain unaffected. Ferromex has stayed silent. Past attempts at state-run passenger rail in the 1990s were plagued by delays and poor reliability. Today’s rail lines, built for slow-moving freight and crisscrossed by road intersections, aren’t designed for speed. Even if trains start running, passengers may still face journeys lasting days. Other planned routes include connections to Coatzacoalcos, Querétaro, Aguascalientes, Pachuca, and even the Pacific port of Manzanillo, which lacks tourist facilities. The decree claims freight will be ‘respected,’ but critics worry this vague promise won’t prevent disruptions.

article_content: In a series of coordinated police raids across France, 19 individuals have been arrested in connection with suspected radical Islamist activity, French President Nicolas Sarkozy announced Friday morning. The operations, carried out in Toulouse, Marseille, Nantes, Lyon, and the Île-de-France region near Paris, were prompted by concerns over extremist ideologies and online declarations of allegiance to jihadist causes. Although none of those arrested have been confirmed as directly linked to Mohammed Merah — the gunman responsible for killing seven people, including three Jewish children, in Toulouse last week — authorities believe the suspects were associated with Forsane Alizza, a banned pro-al-Qaeda group with known ties to the attacker. Interior Minister Claude Gueant revealed that during the raids, authorities seized multiple firearms, including five rifles, four automatic weapons, and three Kalashnikovs, along with a bulletproof vest. Many of the suspects reportedly claimed online to be 'mujahedeen' and stated they had received paramilitary training. Sarkozy emphasized that the crackdown was not solely a response to the Toulouse tragedy but part of a broader effort to remove individuals who reject France’s core values. He compared the national trauma to the aftermath of 9/11 in the U.S., stating, 'We have to be able to draw some conclusions.' Forsane Alizza was outlawed in January 2012 for encouraging French citizens to travel to Afghanistan to join jihadist fights. Merah allegedly attended an al-Qaeda training camp in Afghanistan and Pakistan, according to Paris prosecutor Francois Molins, though his uncle Jamal Azizi denies these claims. Merah was buried Thursday near Toulouse after Algeria refused to accept his body, a move his father attributed to pressure from French authorities. Sarkozy affirmed that further operations are planned to expel those deemed a threat to national security. 'It's absolutely indispensable,' he said, stressing the state’s duty to protect its citizens.

मेराहलाई शुक्रबार टुलुजको बाहिरको एउटा कब्रिस्तानमा दफन गरिएको थियो, किनभने अल्जेरियाले उनको शव स्वीकार गर्न इन्कार गर्यो, जुन उनका बाबुले फ्रान्सीसी अधिकारीहरूको दबाबको कारण भन्छन्। सर्कोजीले आगामी कारवाहीहरू गर्ने निश्चय गर्नुभएको छ जसले देशको सुरक्षाका लागि खतरा बन्ने व्यक्तिहरूलाई बाहिर निकाल्न सक्छ। 'यो निरन्तर अपरिहार्य छ,' उनले भन्नुभएको छ, फ्रान्सीसी नागरिकहरूको सुरक्षाको जिम्मेवारी article_content: On Monday, the European Court of Human Rights ruled that Abu Hamza, a radical Muslim cleric based in the UK, can be extradited to the United States to face multiple terrorism-related charges. No specific date has been set for his transfer. Hamza, originally from Egypt and also known as Mustafa Kamal Mustafa, is accused of involvement in several serious plots, including the 1998 kidnapping of 16 Westerners in Yemen and efforts to establish a militant training camp in rural Oregon in 1999. He previously served seven years in UK custody for inciting racial hatred at his north London mosque. In a unanimous decision signed by seven judges from across Europe, the court concluded that extradition would not violate human rights, even under the strict conditions of US supermax prisons. While inmates face prolonged isolation, the court emphasized they retain access to books, television, family visits, and recreational activities — and that such restrictions are justified given the severity of the alleged crimes. The UK Home Office and the US Department of Justice both welcomed the ruling, describing it as a critical step in international counterterrorism cooperation. Also cleared for extradition are four others: Syed Thala Ahsan, Adel Abdul Bary, Khaled Al-Fawwaz, and Babar Ahmad. Ahmad is accused of fundraising for Chechen militants via US-based websites and supplying gas masks to the Taliban. Bary and Al-Fawwaz face charges connected to the 1998 bombings of US embassies in Nairobi and Dar es Salaam, which killed more than 200 people. A sixth suspect, Haroon Rashid Aswat, remains detained at Broadmoor psychiatric hospital due to schizophrenia; his extradition is on hold pending further medical assessment. If convicted, some defendants could receive life sentences — a prospect the court deemed neither disproportionate nor inhumane.

article_content: By Steve Robson. PUBLISHED: 08:10 EST, 30 November 2012. | UPDATED: 13:58 EST, 30 November 2012. This is the horrifying moment a drunk driver plowed into a pub at 60 mph—just seconds after a group of customers had been standing in the doorway. Leigh Brennan, 45, a known problem drinker, had already injured two people after crashing into a Mini, then fled the scene. He later lost control again in his Volvo estate car, smashing into the Three Elms pub in Brixham, Devon. The impact left landlord Kevin O’Neill seriously injured under a pile of rubble. Devon and Cornwall Police have released shocking CCTV footage in a bid to warn drivers of the dangers of drink-driving ahead of Christmas. The pub’s pool team had been standing outside smoking moments before the vehicle slammed head-on into the entrance. Bystanders rushed to help pull Brennan from his car and dig out O’Neill, who suffered a crushed pelvis, broken ribs, spinal injuries, and required skin grafts. His heart also went into arrhythmia due to trauma. O’Neill spent three days in intensive care and underwent three surgeries. Brennan staggered out of his vehicle, shouting abuse at bystanders and police. He refused to provide a breath or blood sample, though witnesses confirmed he was visibly intoxicated. He pleaded guilty to dangerous driving at Exeter Crown Court and was sentenced to 12 months in jail and a two-year driving ban. Speaking afterward, O’Neill said: 'I was seriously ill. I spent three days in intensive care and had three operations—for a broken pelvis, three fractured vertebrae, broken ribs, skin grafts, and cardiac arrhythmia triggered by shock. The price of a taxi is the price of a pint.' Inspector Richard Pryce, head of Devon and Cornwall Police Roads Policing, said: 'The devastation caused by drink-driving is clear in this footage. A group of people were standing outside the pub just moments before the crash—it’s a miracle no one was killed. The number of people killed or seriously injured by impaired drivers is far too high—and entirely preventable. If you drink and drive, your chances of being caught are high, and the consequences are life-changing. Beyond tragedy, you risk losing your job, your license, facing heavy fines, or imprisonment.'

कर्नवाल प्रहरीले श्रीष्टि अगाडि पीन ड्राइभिङको खतरालाई चेतावनी दिन एउटा भयानक सीसीटीभी फुटेज प्रकाशित गरेका छन्। पबको पुल टिम बाहिर धूम्रपान गर्दै खडा भएका थिए जब गाडीले सिधै प्रवेश द्वारमा टक्कर मार्यो। प्रत्यक्षदर्शीहरूले ब्रेननलाई आफ्नो कारबाट तान्न र ओ'निललाई ईंटाको ढोकाबाट खोजेर निकाल्न मद्दत गरे। ओ'निललाई टाउको टुटेको, तीन वटा कमरको हड्डी टुटेको, र त्वचाको ग्राफ्टको आवश्यकता परेको थियो। उनको हृदय झट्काकारण अनियमित धड्कनमा परेको थियो। ओ'निलले तीन दिन इन्टेन्सिभ केयरमा बिताए र तीन शल्यक्रिया गराए। ब्रेननले आफ्नो कारबाट टाढा निस्केर आसपासका मानिसहरू र प्रहरीलाई अपमान गरे। उनले श्वास वा रक्त परीक्षण दिन इन्कार गरे, तर आँखाले देखेका प्रत्यक्षदर्शीहरूले उनको मद्यप भएको पुष्टि गरे। उनले एक्सेटर क्राउन कोर्टमा खतरनाक ड्राइभिङको लागि दोषी पाइएपछि १२ महिनाको कारावास र दुई वर्षको ड्राइभिङ प्रतिबन्धको दण्ड भोगेका छन्। पछि ओ'निलले भने: 'म गम्भीर रूपमा बीमार थिएँ। मैले तीन दिन इन्टेन्सिभ केयरमा बिताएँ र टुटेको टाउको, तीन वटा टुटेका कमरका हड्डी, टुटेका पाँच तिर र त्वचाको ग्राफ्टको लागि तीन शल्यक्रिया गराएँ। मेरो हृदय झट्काकारण अनियमित धड्कनमा परेको थियो। एउटा ट्याक्सीको मूल्य एउटा पिन्टको मूल्य हो।' डेभन र कर्नवाल प्रहरीका रोड पोलिसिङका प्रमुख इन्स्पेक्टर रिचर्ड प्राइसले भने: 'पीन ड्राइभिङले गर्ने विनाश यो सीसीटीभी फुटेजमा स्पष्ट देखिन्छ। टक्कर भएको केही क्षण पहिले नै पबको बाहिर एउटा समूह खडा भएको थियो—यो चमत्कार हो कि कसैलाई मर्न सकेन र केवल एकजनालाई चोट लाग्यो। मद्यप वा औषधिको प्रभावमा ड्राइभ गर्ने ड्राइभरले जीवन गुमाएका वा गम्भीर रूपमा चोटिएका मानिसहरूको संख्या धेरै ठूलो छ र यो घटाउन सकिन्छ। यदि तपाईं मद्यप भएर ड्राइभ गर्नुभयो भने प्रहरीले तपाईंलाई पक्राउने सम्भावना धेरै छ र परिणाम जीवन परिवर्तन गर्ने हुन्छ। दुःखद परिणामको अतिरिक्त, मद्यप ड्राइभिङमा पक्राउने व्यक्तिले आफ्नो जीवन बिताउने तरिका, ड्राइभिङ प्रतिबन्ध, भारी जरिवाना वा कारावास गर्न सक्छ।'

article_content: A Dutch couple kidnapped in Yemen last month pleaded for help in a video released on Monday. 'We have been kidnapped here in Yemen and we have a big problem,' the woman said in a 90-second video posted online. The couple added that they had contacted the Dutch ambassador to Yemen regarding their kidnappers’ demands and were appealing for assistance. A spokesperson for the Dutch Foreign Ministry stated: 'The Foreign Minister announced on the Ministry’s Facebook page that the government is deeply concerned for the safety of its citizens. The situation is receiving the government’s full attention, and the families of the abducted individuals have been contacted.' The couple was abducted on June 15 as they left their home in the Hadda zone, one of the most secure areas of Sanaa, Yemen’s capital. They were reported missing for a week before authorities and the Dutch embassy were notified. A tribal leader involved in mediation told CNN that the couple’s health remains stable, though they are experiencing depression. 'The kidnappers are demanding a ransom, but have not yet disclosed the amount,' said the leader, who requested anonymity due to the sensitivity of the matter. The tribal leader added that the Yemeni government has indirectly enlisted several tribal leaders to help secure the couple’s safe release, emphasizing: 'Our priority is the safety of the Dutch couple.' When contacted by CNN, the Yemeni Interior Ministry declined to identify those responsible, stating: 'For the best interest of the case, no comments can be made. However, I can assure you we are doing everything possible.' The official did not confirm whether the government knew the couple’s location. Interior Ministry records indicate approximately 35 kidnapping attempts have occurred in Yemen this year. Most victims have been released unharmed. In May, Al Qaeda was suspected in the abduction of a South African couple. In December, a Finnish couple and an Austrian national were held by tribesmen and released five months later after mediation involving Oman. Last week, Yemeni activists launched an online petition urging the government to treat the Dutch couple’s case with urgency. The Yemeni Journalist Syndicate (YJS) condemned the kidnapping, stating that local groups are using abduction as leverage against state authorities.

सेकेण्डको भिडियोमा भनिन्। जोडीले आफ्ना अपहरणकर्ताहरूको मागको बारेमा डच यमन दूतावाससँग कुरा गरेको र मद्दतको निम्ति अपील गरेको थियो। डच विदेश मन्त्रालयकी एक प्रवक्ताले भनिन्: 'विदेश मन्त्रीले मन्त्रालयको फेसबुक पृष्ठमा घोषणा गर्नुभएको थियो कि सरकार आफ्ना नागरिकहरूको सुरक्षाको बारेमा चिन्तित छ। यो स्थिति सरकारको पूर्ण ध्यान लागेको छ र अपहरण भएका व्यक्तिहरूका परिवारहरूलाई सम्पर्क गरिएको छ।' जोडीलाई जुन १५ मा साना, यमनको राजधानीको सबैभन्दा सुरक्षित क्षेत्रहरूमध्ये एक हुने हड्डा क्षेत्रबाट घरबाट निस्कने बेला अपहरण गरिएको थियो। उनीहरूको अनुपस्थिति एक हप्ता सम्म अनजान रहेपछि अधिकारीहरू र डच दूतावासलाई सूचना दिइएको थियो। मध्यस्थतामा संलग्न एक जना जनजातीय नेताले सीएनएनलाई भन्नुभयो कि डच जोडीको स्वास्थ्य स्थिर छ तर उनीहरू निराशामा छन्। 'अपहरणकर्ताहरूले एउटा बलि मागेका छन्, तर त्यो कति हो भन्ने कुरा अहिले सम्म घोषणा गरेका छैनन्,' भन्दै नेताले संवेदनशीलताको कारण आफ्नो नाम गुप्त राख्न अनुरोध गर्नुभयो। नेताले थप्नुभयो कि यमन सरकारले जोडीको सुरक्षित छुट्टाउन सहयोग गर्न धेरै जनजातीय नेताहरूलाई अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा सम्पर्क गरेको छ र भन्नुभयो, 'हाम्रो प्राथमिकता डच जोडीको सुरक्षा हो।' सीएनएनले सम्पर्क गर्दा यमन आन्तरिक मन्त्रालयले अपहरण गर्ने व्यक्तिहरूको पहिचान गर्न अस्वीकार गर्यो। 'यो मामलाको लागि सर्वोत्तम हितमा यो मन्त्रालयले टिप्पणी गर्न सक्दैन। तर म तपाईंलाई आश्वासन दिन्छु कि हामी सबै सम्भव काम गरिरहेका छौं,' एक उच्च अधिकारीले भन्नुभयो। अधिकारीले सरकारले डच जोडीको ठेगाना जान्छ कि छैन भन्ने कुरा पनि उल्लेख गरेन। आन्तरिक मन्त्रालयका रेकर्डहरूले यमनमा यो वर्ष लगभग ३५ वटा अपहरणको प्रयास भएको देखाउँछ। धेरै बलि अक्षत छुट्टिएका छन्। मे महिनामा एउटा दक्षिण अफ्रिकी जोडीको अपहरणमा अल कायदालाई सन्देह गरिएको छ। डिसेम्बरमा एउटा फिनिस जोडी र एक अस्ट्रियाई व्यक्तिलाई जनजातीय समूहले अपहरण गरेको थियो र ओमानको मध्यस्थतामा पाँच महिना पछि छुट्टाइएको थियो। पछिल्लो हप्ता, यमनमा एक सामाजिक कार्यकर्ताहरूले डच जोडीको अपहरणको मामलालाई गम्भीरतापूर्वक लिन यमन सरकारमा दबाब डाल्न ऑनलाइन हस्ताक्षर अभियान सुरू गरे। यमन जर्नलिस्ट सिन्डिकेट (YJS) ले अपहरणलाई निन्दा गर्दै भन्यो कि स्थानीय समूहहरू राज्यको खिलाफ अपहरणलाई एउटा बार्गेनिङ चिपको रूपमा प्रयोग गरिरहेका छन्।

article_content: Ruud van Nistelrooy has drawn parallels between Louis van Gaal’s managerial style and that of Sir Alex Ferguson, predicting that van Gaal will restore Manchester United to its former glory. The former United striker, who scored 150 goals in 219 appearances between 2001 and 2006, is currently working as a pundit for ESPN during the World Cup. Speaking live during Saturday’s broadcast, the 38-year-old said: 'Everyone will know who’s in charge. He does everything himself — every training session. He’s incredibly hands-on. Louis is a Ferguson-type character, and that’s exactly what United needs right now. He’s a great manager.' Van Gaal is set to take over at Old Trafford after the World Cup and has already made significant moves, signing Ander Herrera and Luke Shaw for a combined £58.8 million. Van Nistelrooy emphasized that van Gaal won’t take a holiday — he plans to dive straight into pre-season training, assess the current squad, and give opportunities to players who impress him, rather than relying solely on big-money signings. He added: 'He’ll start work immediately. There’s no time off. He needs to get to know the players, lead the pre-season tour to the U.S., and prepare for the Premier League. If he sees potential in someone already at the club, he’ll back them.' Van Nistelrooy also praised van Gaal’s leadership of the Netherlands, noting his calm presence and the team’s surprising success — winning all three group matches and scoring 10 goals. He highlighted Arjen Robben’s exceptional form and the strong bond between van Gaal and Robin van Persie, suggesting both will thrive under his guidance at United. Van Nistelrooy, pictured alongside former teammate Edwin van der Sar at the Netherlands training ground, is set to join Gus Hiddink as assistant coach once van Gaal departs the Dutch national team.
translated_content: रुड भान निस्टेलरोयले लुइस भान गालको प्रबन्धन शैली र सर एलेक्स फर्ग्युसनको बीचमा समानता तिर आँखा घुमाएका छन् र भान गालले म्यानचेस्टर युनाइटेडलाई आफ्नो पुरानो महिमामा फर्काउने भन्ने अनुमान गरेका छन्। २००१ देखि २००६ को बीचमा २१९ खेलमा १५० गोल गर्ने यो भूतपूर्व युनाइटेड खिलाडी विश्व कप दौडाने अवसरमा एसपीएनका लागि विश्लेषकको रूपमा काम गर्दैछन्। शनिबारको प्रसारणको दौरान जीवन्त रूपमा बोल्दै ३८ वर्षीय खिलाडीले भने: 'सबैले जान्नेछन् कि को हो नेता। उनले सबै कुरा आफैं गर्छन् — हरेक प्रशिक्षण सत्र। उनि अत्यन्त व्यक्तिगत रूपमा सम्पर्क गर्छन्। लुइस एक फर्ग्युसन जस्तो व्यक्तित्व हुनुहुन्छ, र अहिले युनाइटेडलाई त्यही चाहिएको छ। उनि एक राम्रो प्रबन्धक हुनुहुन्छ।' भान गाल विश्व कप पछि ओल्ड ट्राफोर्डमा आउने छन् र उनले पहिले नै अन्डर हेर्रेरा र लूक शॉलाई एकैसाथ ५८.८ मिलियन पाउन्डमा हस्ताक्षर गरेका छन्। भान निस्टेलरोयले जोड दिएका छन् कि भान गालले छुट्टी लिने छैनन् — उनले प्री-सीजन प्रशिक्षणमा तत्काल समावेश हुने छन्, वर्तमान टोलीलाई मूल्याङ्कन गर्ने छन् र ठूलो रकम खर्च गर्नुभन्दा अझ राम्रो खेल्ने खिलाडीहरूलाई अवसर दिने छन्। उनले थप्नुभएको: 'उनि तत्काल काम सुरु गर्ने छन्। छुट्टी केही छैन। उनलाई खिलाडीहरूलाई जान्नुपर्छ, अमेरिकाको प्री-सीजन यात्रा नेतृत्व गर्नुपर्छ, र प्रिमियर लीगको लागि तयारी गर्नुपर्छ। यदि उनले कुनै खिलाडीमा सम्भावना देख्नुहुन्छ भने, उनले त्यसलाई समर्थन गर्नेछन्।' भान निस्टेलरोयले भान गालको नेदरल्यान्ड्सको नेतृत्व प्रशंसा गर्दै उनको शान्त व्यवहार र टोलीको अप्रत्याशित सफलतालाई उल्लेख गरे — तीनै समूह खेल जितेर १० गोल गरेको। उनले अर्जेन रोबेनको असाधारण फिटनेस र भान गाल र रोबिन भान पर्सीबीचको मजबूत सम्बन्धलाई उल्लेख गरे, जसले दुवै खिलाडी युनाइटेडमा उनको नेतृत्वमा उत्कृष्ट खेल्नेछन् भन्ने अनुमान गरे। भान निस्टेलरोय, जसले भूतपूर्व सहकर्मी एड्विन भान डर सारसँग नेदरल्यान्ड्सको प्रशिक्षण स्थलमा फोटो खिचाएका छन्, भान गालको नेदरल्यान्ड्स टिमबाट निस्किएपछि गस हिडिङ्कका सहायक प्रशिक्षक बन्ने तयारी गर्दैछन्।

article_content: Australia’s cricket captain, Michael Clarke, has announced that Phillip Hughes’ One Day International shirt number, 64, will be permanently retired by Cricket Australia in honor of the late batsman. Hughes tragically passed away on Thursday, 27 November 2014, following injuries sustained during a Sheffield Shield match on Tuesday, when he was struck on the head by a bouncer bowled by New South Wales fast bowler Sean Abbott. Speaking through tears at a press conference on Saturday, Clarke revealed that he had requested the retirement of Hughes’ ODI number — a gesture Cricket Australia swiftly approved. Clarke described Hughes as a man who lived with joy, humility, and an unwavering passion for cricket. 'Where else would you rather be, boys, than playing cricket for your country?' Hughes often said — words that now resonate deeply with his teammates. Clarke paid tribute to Hughes’ spirit, calling him a true embodiment of the Baggy Green, and expressed that the team’s dressing room will never be the same. 'We loved him, and we always will.' He extended heartfelt condolences to Hughes’ parents, Greg and Virginia, and his siblings, Jason and Megan, sharing their profound grief. Clarke did not address whether Australia will play its upcoming Test against India in Brisbane, scheduled for next Thursday. However, former captain Ricky Ponting stated it would be unfair to expect players to compete so soon after such a tragedy. 'I don’t think it would be right,' Ponting wrote. 'Even if the boys think they can play, it would be a miracle if they find the right frame of mind for five days of cricket.' The cricket world mourns the loss of a beloved figure — a man whose infectious grin and love for the game touched countless lives.
translated_content: ऑस्ट्रेलियाका कप्तान माइकल क्लार्कले फिलिप ह्यूजसको एकदिवसीय अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय शर्ट नम्बर ६४ लाई स्थायी रूपमा सेवा बाट निकाल्ने घोषणा गरेका छन्। ह्यूजस बुधबार, २७ नोभेम्बर २०१४ मा शेफिल्ड शील्ड खेलमा मंगलबार न्यू साउथ वेल्सका फास्ट बलर सीन एबटको बाउन्सरले सिरमा परेपछि घाइते भएर अन्तिम श्वास त्याग्नुभएको थियो। शनिबारको प्रेस सम्मेलनमा आँखामा आँसु लिएर क्लार्कले भन्नुभयो, 'मैले क्रिकेट ऑस्ट्रेलियालाई ह्यूजसको ओडीआई नम्बर ६४ लाई सेवा बाट निकाल्न अनुरोध गरेको थिएँ, र तिनीहरूले सहमति जनाए।' क्लार्कले ह्यूजसलाई खुशी, विनम्रता र क्रिकेटप्रति अटूट प्रेमले भरिएको व्यक्ति भनी वर्णन गर्नुभयो। 'बालीहरू, तपाईंहरू कहाँ अर्को ठाउँमा हुन चाहनुहुन्छ? आफ्नो देशका लागि क्रिकेट खेल्दै?' ह्यूजसले अहिले सम्म यो वाक्य बारम्बार भन्नुहुन्थ्यो। क्लार्कले ह्यूजसको आत्मा र ब्यागी ग्रीनको वास्तविक रूप भनी सम्मान गर्नुभयो र भन्नुभयो, 'हाम्रो ड्रेसिङ रुम कहिल्यै पनि पहिलेको जस्तो हुने छैन। हामीले उनलाई प्रेम गर्थ्यौँ, र हामी सधैँ गर्नेछौँ।' उनले ह्यूजसका आमाबाबु ग्रेग र भर्जिनिया, र उनका भाइबहिनी जेसन र मेगनलाई गहिरो शोक व्यक्त गर्नुभयो। क्लार्कले अगाडि आउने भारत विरुद्धको परीक्षण खेलको बारेमा कुनै टिप्पणी गरेनन्, जुन अर्को बुधबार ब्रिस्बेनमा खेलिने थियो। तर अघिल्लो कप्तान रिकी पोन्टिङले भन्नुभयो, 'यो समयमा खेल्न खेलाडीहरूलाई अनुमति दिनु अन्याय हुनेछ। मलाई लाग्छ, यो उचित हुने छैन। यदि खेलाडीहरूले खेल्न सक्छन् भने पनि, पाँच दिनको क्रिकेटका लागि सही मनोदशा पाउनु अद्भुत हुनेछ।' क्रिकेट संसारले एक प्रिय व्यक्तिको नुकसान देखाएको छ — जसले आफ्नो उज्ज्वल मुस्कान र क्रिकेटप्रति प्रेमले असंख्य जीवनलाई छुएको थियो।
