article_content: European Tour CEO George O'Grady has been forced to apologize for using the term 'coloured' in an inappropriate manner. The head of the European golf tour issued a statement after saying in a live Sky Sports interview: 'Most of Sergio's friends are coloured athletes in the United States.' O'Grady, who is British, later stated: 'I deeply regret using an inappropriate word in a live interview for Sky Sports, for which I unreservedly apologize.' The remarks come amid an ongoing controversy involving Spanish golfer Sergio Garcia and Tiger Woods, which began during the third round of The Players Championship. At that event, Garcia suggested Woods deliberately stirred up the crowd while he was playing a shot. The situation escalated when, during a dinner with his Ryder Cup teammates, Garcia joked in response to a question from Golf Channel’s Steve Sands: 'We'll have him round every night. We will serve fried chicken.' The comment echoed Fuzzy Zoeller’s similar remark after Woods won the 1997 Masters — becoming the first golfer of Black heritage to win a major championship. Garcia initially issued an apology and repeated it at a news conference at the BMW PGA Championship at Wentworth, the European Tour’s flagship event. 'I feel sick about it and I feel truly, truly sorry,' Garcia said. 'I meant to give a funny answer to a playful question, but it turned out to be totally stupid and out of place.' In a series of tweets, Woods responded: 'The comment that was made wasn’t silly. It was wrong, hurtful, and clearly inappropriate. I’m confident there is real regret that the remark was made. The Players ended nearly two weeks ago — it’s long past time to move on and talk about golf.'
translated_content: युरोपियन टूरका सीईओ जर्ज ओ'ग्राडीले 'कलर्ड' शब्द प्रयोग गर्ने अनुचित तरिकामा माफी मागेका छन्। युरोपियन गोल्फ टूरका नेता लाइभ स्काई स्पोर्ट्स साक्षात्कारमा भन्नुभएको थियो: 'सर्जियोका धेरै मित्रहरू अमेरिकाका कलर्ड खेलाडीहरू हुन्।' ब्रिटिश नागरिक ओ'ग्राडीले पछि बताए: 'मैले स्काई स्पोर्ट्सको लाइभ साक्षात्कारमा अनुचित शब्द प्रयोग गरेकोमा मलाई गहिरो दुःख छ, र म निःशर्त रूपमा माफी माग्छु।' यी टिप्पणीहरू विवादको अवस्थामा आएका हुन्, जुन स्पेनिश गोल्फर सर्जियो गार्सिया र टाइगर वुड्स बीचमा शुरू भएको थियो, जुन द रेलर्स च्याम्पियनशिपको तेस्रो राउन्डमा भएको थियो। त्यस समय, गार्सियाले वुड्सले आफ्नो शॉट खेल्दा दर्शकहरूलाई जाग्रत गर्न जानबुझेर गरेको बताए। स्थिति त्यतिबेला बढ्यो जब उनका राइडर कप साथीहरूसँग डिनरमा गोल्फ च्यानलका स्टिभ स्यान्सले उनलाई प्रश्न गर्नुभयो: 'तपाईंले यूएस ओपनमा वुड्सलाई डिनरमा आमन्त्रित गर्नुहुन्छ?' 'हामी उनलाई प्रत्येक रात आमन्त्रित गर्नेछौं। हामी फ्राइड चिकन खुवाउनेछौं,' गार्सियाले जवाफ दिए। यो टिप्पणी १९९७ मा वुड्सले मास्टर्स जितेपछि फजी जोएलरले गरेको समान टिप्पणीलाई याद गराउँछ — जब वुड्स ब्ल्याक वंशका पहिलो खेलाडी बने र मेजर जिते। गार्सियाले पहिले नै माफी मागेका थिए र युरोपियन टूरको मुख्य घटना बिएमडब्ल्यू पीजीए च्याम्पियनशिपमा न्यूज कन्फ्रेन्समा पनि फेरि माफी मागेका थिए। 'मलाई यो बारे बिराम लाग्छ र म वास्तविक रूपमा दुःखी छु,' गार्सियाले भन्नुभयो। 'म एउटा मजाकी जवाफ दिन खोजेको थिएँ, तर यो पूरै बेवकुफी र अनुपयुक्त निकल्यो।' बुधबार ट्विटरमा वुड्सले जवाफ दिनुभयो: 'भनिएको टिप्पणी मजाकी थिएन। यो गलत, दुःखद र स्पष्ट रूपमा अनुचित थियो। म विश्वास गर्छु कि यो टिप्पणी गरिएकोमा वास्तविक दुःख छ। द रेलर्स लगभग दुई हप्ता अघि सकिएको थियो — अब गोल्फको बारेमा कुरा गर्नु नै समय भएको छ।'

article_content: For Widline Germain, the silence from her family in Haiti isn’t just unsettling—it feels like a void swallowing an entire community. Back in New York after a holiday visit, the 25-year-old recent college graduate now counts nearly 400 relatives across Haiti, and most are unaccounted for. 'It’s like I’m living someone else’s nightmare,' she says, staring at photos of the presidential palace still glowing with Christmas lights the day before the quake. The bed she slept in is now rubble. Each name she recites carries weight: her mother’s sister and all four children. Her father’s brother. Cousins barely old enough to walk. Some last called from Jérémie, a remote town where roads are gone and aid hasn’t reached. They spoke of thirst, hunger, and sleeping amid the dead. One uncle, mentally disabled, said he was beaten by looters in the capital. Germain’s voice cracks when she talks about the children—ages two to seven—who’ve walked past corpses just to find water. 'We’re here with clean water and warm beds,' she says, 'and they’re out there, dying. It’s not fair.' But she won’t sit idle. Along with her parents and other relatives in Binghamton, she’s already planning to open their home, their lives, to whoever survives. 'We’ve got degrees, jobs, space,' she insists. 'We’ll make it work. Family doesn’t get left behind.'
translated_content: विडलिन गरमेनका लागि हैतीमा आफ्नो परिवारबाट आएको चुपचाप असहज मात्र होइन—यो पूरा समुदायलाई निल्किएको खाली ठाउँ जस्तो लाग्छ। छुट्टी पछि न्यू योर्क फर्किएपछि, २५ वर्षीय निकालेको कलेज ग्रेजुएटले हैतीमा लगभग ४०० जना विस्तारित परिवारका सदस्यहरू छन् भनेर गणना गर्छिन्, र धेरै जना अहिले सम्पर्क भएको छैन। 'म अरूको सपनामा बसेकी जस्तो लाग्छ,' उनले भनिन्, भूकम्प आउनुअघिल्लो दिन राष्ट्रपति कार्यालयको शीशा बत्तीले उज्यालो भएको फोटोहरू हेर्दै। उनी निद्रा गर्ने बिछौना अहिले धूलो भएको छ। उनले नामहरू उल्लेख गर्दा प्रत्येकले भार लिएको छ: आमाकी बहिनी र उनका चार बच्चाहरू। बाबुको भाइ। चल्न सक्ने उमेरभन्दा पनि छोटा भाइबहिनीहरू। केही जनाले जेरेमीबाट अन्तिम फोन गरेका थिए—एउटा दूरदराजको शहर जहाँ सडकहरू नष्ट भएका छन् र सहायता अहिले सम्म पुगेको छैन। उनीहरूले पानी, खाना र मृत शरीरहरूको बीचमा सुत्ने बारे कुरा गरेका थिए। एक चाचा, मानसिक रूपमा अक्षम, भन्छन् कि उनलाई क्यापिटलमा लुटेरहरूले हल्लाएका थिए। गरमेनले दुई देखि सात वर्षका बच्चाहरूको बारेमा कुरा गर्दा आवाज फाटिन्छ—उनीहरूले सडकमा मृत शरीरहरू पार गरेर पानी खोज्नुपरेको छ। 'हामी यहाँ सफा पानी र गरम बिछौनाको साथ छौं,' उनले भनिन्, 'तर तिनीहरू बाहिर, मर्दै गएका छन्। यो अन्याय हो।' तर उनी बसेर छैनन्। बिङ्गम्पटनमा उनका आमा-बाबु र अरू सम्बन्धीहरूसँग मिलेर, उनीहरू जीवित बचेकालाई आफ्नो घर, आफ्नो जीवन खोल्न तयार छन्। 'हाम्रो पासा डिग्री, नौकरी, ठूलो घर छ,' उनले जोर दिएर भनिन्, 'हामी व्यवस्था गर्न सक्छौं। परिवारलाई छोड्दैनौं।'

article_content: Married men: Is your partner spending more time at work? A recent study suggests this might signal her concern about the future of your marriage. Researchers from the London School of Economics (LSE) found that women who perceive a higher risk of divorce tend to increase their working hours—as a form of financial insurance. For every 1% rise in the perceived risk of marital breakdown, women added approximately 12 extra minutes to their weekly work schedule. The study, led by Berkay Ozcan and based on data following Ireland’s 1996 legalization of divorce, revealed that non-religious married women increased their labor force participation by about 18%, while religious women—whose communities largely opposed divorce—showed no significant change. This contrast helped researchers isolate the effect of legal access to divorce. Crucially, the rise in women’s work hours was not matched by a reduction in household duties or an increase in fathers’ childcare involvement. Women continued managing both careers and domestic responsibilities, often at the cost of personal time and well-being. Interestingly, the study found no similar pattern among men. While some men may extend work hours to avoid tense home environments—as noted by British divorce lawyer Ayesha Vardag—the LSE data showed no systematic increase tied to divorce risk. Adding another layer, Swedish research from Stockholm University challenged the long-standing belief that women are naturally better at multitasking. Professor Timo Maentylae’s findings indicated that men, on average, outperformed women in simultaneous task handling—with performance gaps linked to fluctuations in the female menstrual cycle. Ozcan emphasized that while divorce may initially harm women financially—due to existing wage and asset disparities—it may also empower them over time by strengthening their economic independence. The study concludes that women’s growing workforce presence is not merely a response to opportunity, but often a strategic adaptation to insecurity.

article_content: Are you ready for a heartwarming love story? The upcoming Korean film 'Single in Seoul' has just dropped a captivating new trailer—and it’s pure magic! Starring Lee Dong Wook and Im Soo Jung, the film tells the charming tale of two opposites whose lives intersect while working on a book about singlehood in the modern city. Lee Dong Wook plays Young Ho, a beloved writer and influencer who thrives in solitude, declaring, 'I’m the only one who’s perfect for me.' Meanwhile, Im Soo Jung portrays Hyun Jin, the sharp yet endearingly clumsy editor-in-chief of a publishing house. As they collaborate on the book titled 'Single in the City,' their worlds slowly collide—filled with quiet moments, laughter, and growing affection. The trailer also introduces supporting characters: Hyun Jin’s coworkers Yoon Jung, Byung Soo, and Ye Ri, along with writer Hong and publishing CEO Pyo. Set against the vibrant backdrops of Seoul and Barcelona, the visuals are stunning. The poster captures Young Ho’s gentle smile beside Hyun Jin’s adorable, slightly disheveled charm. article_content: Roy Keane has revealed in his autobiography, 'The Second Half,' that Sir Alex Ferguson repeatedly confronted him about his drinking during his early years at Manchester United. The former United captain, now assistant manager at Aston Villa, candidly admitted that alcohol was his 'hobby' at the time — a habit shaped by loneliness, boredom, and being single in his early 20s. In an interview with ShortList magazine, Keane confirmed Ferguson often questioned him about late-night outings, saying, 'Of course he did — and quite rightly.' He dismissed the notion that their conflicts were limited to one explosive fallout, emphasizing they had 'loads' of disagreements — many centered on his drinking. Keane explained his behavior: 'I wasn’t a golfer. I lived alone. I was Irish. Boredom kicked in.' While he doesn’t endorse the habit, he acknowledges it as part of his personality. Though he hasn’t read Ferguson’s own book, Keane affirmed their deep mutual respect, adding, 'Even when I left, I think we both felt it was right for Manchester United.' He did, however, express frustration over post-departure comments he deemed unfair. A photograph from 1995 shows Keane celebrating during his peak United years — a visual reminder of the era he reflects upon with honesty and nuance.

article_content: Facing a growing shortage of lethal injection drugs, several U.S. states are turning back to older execution methods—including firing squads, electrocution, and gas chambers—as potential alternatives. Missouri lawmakers, led by Republican Representative Rick Brattin, are pushing to reintroduce firing squads not out of nostalgia, but as a practical fix. 'It’s not about going back to the 1850s,' Brattin says. 'It’s about finding a way to carry out sentences without endless legal delays.' The push comes after multiple botched lethal injections raised serious concerns. In Ohio, Dennis McGuire took 26 minutes to die, gasping painfully. In Oklahoma, Michael Lee Wilson cried out, 'I feel my whole body burning.' These incidents, combined with European drug manufacturers refusing to supply execution chemicals, have left states scrambling. Missouri replaced its three-drug protocol first with propofol—a drug famously linked to Michael Jackson’s death—and later with a compounded form of pentobarbital obtained from an undisclosed pharmacy. But secrecy sparked lawsuits and legislative scrutiny. Meanwhile, Wyoming’s Senator Bruce Burns argues that firing squads are cheaper than rebuilding gas chambers, especially since the state hasn’t executed anyone in over two decades. Virginia is considering restoring the electric chair if drugs become unavailable. Although most states abandoned these methods decades ago to appear more civilized, some now see them as necessary backups. Only three civilian firing squad executions have occurred in the U.S. since the Civil War—all in Utah. The most recent was Ronnie Lee Gardner in 2010. Utah is phasing out the method but still allows it for those sentenced before May 3, 2004. Oklahoma permits it only if lethal injection and electrocution are ruled unconstitutional. Hanging remains an option in three states, though the last execution by hanging was in 1996. Critics, including Richard Dieter of the Death Penalty Information Center, warn that returning to such methods could trigger public outrage and undermine support for capital punishment altogether. 'People might recoil,' he says. 'It risks turning justice into spectacle.' Meanwhile, some politicians argue that victims’ families deserve closure, not decades-long waits. As states navigate legal, ethical, and logistical hurdles, the debate reveals a deeper tension: how far should society go to punish the worst offenders?

article_content: This Friday, take a moment to appreciate the little marks that make language clear — the comma, the period, the semicolon, even the exclamation point. It’s National Punctuation Day, a quirky but meaningful observance born from one man’s irritation with bad grammar. Jeff Rubin, a 60-year-old former journalist and newsletter writer from the San Francisco suburbs, used to sit at his kitchen table with a red marker, yelling at newspaper errors so loudly it upset his wife. She suggested he channel that energy somewhere else — so he did. In 2004, he officially registered the day in Chase's Calendar of Events. Originally held on August 22 — his birthday — Rubin shifted the date to September 24 in 2006, partly to fit within the school calendar and partly to honor his favorite baseball player, Willie Mays, whose jersey number was 24. Rubin didn’t start this just for grammar nerds. He wanted teachers to remind students that punctuation still matters — even in the age of texting and tweets. 'We’re graduating kids who can’t read or write,' he says. 'They won’t be able to get jobs.' His newsletter, 'The Exclamation Point!', has drawn thousands of subscribers, including educators, lawyers, and HR professionals. He’s not the only one pushing the cause. A popular Facebook group with over 800,000 members echoes his message with the classic example: 'Let’s eat Grandma!' versus 'Let’s eat, Grandma!' — punctuation, literally, saves lives. British author Lynne Truss took it further in her book 'Eats, Shoots & Leaves,' using a fictional panda story to show how a missing comma can turn a peaceful meal into a violent scene. Rubin keeps the mood playful: his website showcases funny punctuation fails and even includes a recipe for meatloaf molded into exclamation points and semicolons. Last year, schools joined in with pepperoni-parentheses bread and question-mark cookies. This year, an Illinois teacher is having students write haiku. And if you need another reason to write something heartfelt this Friday? It’s also Love Note Day.

व्यक्तिको खराब व्याकरणप्रति असहनशीलताबाट उत्पन्न भएको अजीब तर अर्थपूर्ण उत्सव हो। सैन फ्रान्सिस्कोको उपनगरमा बस्ने ६० वर्षीय पूर्व पत्रकार र न्यूजलेटर लेखक जेफ रुबिनले अहिले सम्म अखबारका त्रुटिहरूलाई चेजको क्यालेन्डर अफ इभेन्ट्समा आधिकारिक रूपमा दर्ता गरे। पहिले यो अगस्ट २२ मा मनाइन्थ्यो — उनको जन्मदिन — तर २००६ मा उनले यसलाई सेप्टेम्बर २४ मा लगाए, जसले विद्यालयको वर्षसँग जोडिन्छ र उनको पसन्दको बेसबल खेलाडी, विली मेय्स, जसको जर्सी नम्बर २४ थियो, लाई सम्मान गर्छ। रुबिनले यो केवल व्याकरण नर्डहरूका लागि सुरू गरेका थिएनन्। उनले शिक्षकहरूलाई याद गराउन चाहनुभएको थियो कि विराम चिन्हहरू अहिले पनि महत्त्वपूर्ण छन् — टेक्स्ट र ट्विटको युगमा पनि। 'हामी तिनीहरूलाई उच्च विद्यालयबाट त्यस्तो निकालिरहेका छौं जसले पढ्न वा लेख्न सक्दैनन्,' उनले भन्नुहुन्छ। 'यी बच्चाहरू वास्तविक जीवनमा जाँदा बेरोजगार हुनेछन्।' उनको न्यूजलेटर, 'एक्स्क्लेमेसन प्वाइन्ट!', मा हजारौं ग्राहकहरू सामेल भएका छन्, जसमा शिक्षक, वकिल, र मानव संसाधन प्रबन्धकहरू समावेश छन्। उनको मात्र नभएर अरू पनि यो आन्दोलन चलाइरहेका छन्। ८ लाख भन्दा बढी अनुयायी भएको फेसबुक समूहले यसलाई यसरी उठाउँछ: 'आउनुहोस्, बाबु!' वा 'आउनुहोस् बाबु!' — विराम चिन्ह, अक्षरशः जीवन बचाउँछ। ब्रिटिश लेखिका लिन ट्रसले आफ्नो पुस्तक 'ईट्स, शूट्स एन्ड लीभ्स' मा यसलाई अझ बढाएकी छिन्, जहाँ उनले एउटा काल्पनिक पाण्डा कथा प्रयोग गरेर देखाउनुभएको छ कि एउटा गल्तीको कमा कसरी शान्त भोजनलाई हिंसात्मक दृश्यमा परिणत गर्न सक्छ। रुबिनले यसलाई खेलकुद रूपमा राख्छन्: उनको वेबसाइटमा अजीब विराम चिन्हका त्रुटिहरू र एक्स्क्लेमेसन र सेमीकोलनको आकारमा ढालिएको मिट्ठो बेक गर्ने नुस्खा पनि छ। पछिल्लो वर्ष, विद्यालयहरूले पेपरोनी ब्रेडलाई कोष्ठकको रूपमा र प्रश्नचिन्हको आकारमा कुकी बनाएर उत्सव मनाए। यो वर्ष, इलिनोइसको एक शिक्षिकाले आफ्ना विद्यार्थीहरूलाई हाइकु लेख्न अनुरोध गरेकी छिन्। र यो शुक्रबार तपाईंले केहि मायालु लेख लेख्ने अर्को कारण चाहिएको छ भने? यो दिन लभ नोट दिवस पनि हो।

article_content: The bodies of nearly 800 babies are believed to have been secretly buried in a concrete tank beside a former mother and baby home in Tuam, County Galway, Ireland. Over a 36-year period—from 1925 to 1961—796 infants died at the institution run by the Bon Secours nuns. Most were buried without coffins or headstones, on unconsecrated ground that once held a water tank from the previous workhouse. Newly uncovered records reveal widespread malnutrition and neglect, with causes of death including measles, tuberculosis, pneumonia, gastroenteritis, and convulsions. Many infants were emaciated, poorly clothed, and rarely washed. A 1944 health inspection reported 333 people—271 children and 61 mothers—in a facility designed for 243. No official memorial was ever erected. The site, now surrounded by a housing estate, was accidentally discovered in the 1970s by two boys who broke through a concrete slab and found a chamber filled with skeletons. A priest reportedly blessed the site, but no further action was taken. Local historian Catherine Corless spent years compiling death records from the Galway registrar’s office, confirming 796 infant deaths linked to the home. Only one child was buried in a family plot—evidence, she argues, that the rest were unclaimed and discarded. Relatives of deceased children, such as the family of William Joseph Dolan, have filed missing persons reports with the Gardaí, seeking answers about whether their loved ones were buried or possibly adopted. Some suspect children were sent abroad for adoption without consent. Similar institutions across Ireland—including Sean Ross Abbey in Tipperary—reported alarming infant mortality rates. Between 40,000 and 60,000 children were adopted internationally during the 1950s and 1960s, often without parental consent. Survivors and bereaved mothers now demand full access to records and official recognition of the atrocities. Philomena Lee, whose son was adopted by an American family in 1952, spoke at a recent memorial service, urging the state to open all archives. 'It's not about anger—it's about doing what's right,' she said. 'They tried to hide this. But the truth must be told.' One survivor, Mary, who lived in the home from age four in 1932, recalled freezing conditions, rotten food, and cruel punishments. 'We were filthy dirty,' she said. 'I never liked nuns after they dunked me in a cold bath for soiling myself.'
translated_content: लगभग ८०० शिशुहरूको लाश आइरिसको टुअममा रहेको एउटा पुरानो अवैवाहिक आमाहरूको घरको बगैँचामा रहेको एउटा संघनित ट्याङ्कमा दफन गरिएको हुनसक्छ। १९२५ देखि १९६१ सम्मको ३६ वर्षको अवधिमा बोन सेकोर्स ननहरूले सञ्चालन गर्ने यो संस्थामा ७९६ शिशुहरू मृत्यु भएका थिए। धेरैलाई लिपट, लास वा शीर्षक नभएको अपवित्र जमिनमा दफन गरिएको थियो, जुन पहिलेको कामको घरको पानीको ट्याङ्क थियो। हालै उजागर भएका रिकर्डहरूले देखाउँछ कि भोक, उपेक्षा र अन्य बीमारीहरू जस्तै मिजल्स, टिबी, निमोनिया, ग्यास्ट्रोएन्टेराइटिस र कन्भल्सनले धेरै शिशुहरूको मृत्यु भएको थियो। १९४४ मा एउटा स्वास्थ्य जाँचले २७१ शिशु र ६१ अवैवाहिक आमाहरू—कुल ३३३ जना—लाई २४३ जनाको क्षमता भएको संस्थामा राखिएको देखाएको छ। कुनै औपचारिक स्मारक कहिल्यै निर्माण गरिएको थिएन। यो स्थल अहिले एउटा आवासीय बस्तीले घेरिएको छ, जुन १९७० को दशकमा दुई बच्चाहरूले संघनित पट्टी तोडेर ढोका भित्रको खोप्राहरूले भरिएको ठाउँ पत्ता लगाएपछि उजागर भएको थियो। एउटा पाद्रीले यसलाई आशीर्वाद गरेको थियो, तर त्यसपछि कुनै कारवाही भएको थिएन। स्थानीय इतिहासकार क्याथरिन कोरलेसले गाल्वे रजिस्ट्रारको कार्यालयबाट मृत्यु रिकर्डहरू सङ्कलन गरेर यो संस्थासँग जोडिएका ७९६ शिशु मृत्यु पुष्टि गरेकी छिन्। केवल एक बच्चालाई मात्र परिवारको कब्रस्थानमा दफन गरिएको थियो—जसले उनीले अरू सबै अनाथ र त्यागिएका भएको तर्क गरेकी छिन्। विलियम जोसेफ डोलन जस्ता मृत बच्चाहरूका रिश्तेदारहरूले गार्डाईलाई गायब भएको बारेमा शिकायत दर्ता गरेका छन्, जसले आफ्ना प्रियजनहरू कब्रमा दफन भएका छन् वा सम्भवतः अन्यत्र अपनाइएका छन् भन्ने जान्न चाहन्छन्। केहीले अनाथ बच्चाहरूलाई बिना अनुमतिको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अपनाउने प्रथालाई अनुमान गर्छन्। आइरिसको विभिन्न स्थानहरूमा—टिपेरेरीको सीन रस एब्बे जस्ता—अन्य संस्थाहरूमा पनि अत्यधिक शिशु मृत्यु दर रहेको थियो। १९५० र १९६० को दशकमा ४०,००० देखि ६०,००० बच्चाहरू अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय रूपमा अपनाइएका थिए, अक्सर आमाहरूको अनुमति बिना। बच्चाहरूका आमाहरू र बच्ने व्यक्तिहरूले अब रिकर्डहरू खोल्न र यी अत्याचारहरूको औपचारिक मान्यता माग्दैछन्। १९५२ मा आफ्नो छोरालाई अमेरिकी परिवारलाई दिएकी फिलोमेना लीले हालैको स्मारक सेवामा भनिन्, 'यो गुस्साको बारेमा होइन, यो गलत भएको कुरा गर्ने बारेमा हो। तिनीहरूले यो छिपाउन खोजेका थिए। तर सत्य भन्नु पर्छ।' १९३२ मा चार वर्षको उमेरमा यस संस्थामा राखिएकी एउटा बच्ने महिला, मेरीले जानकारी दिनुभयो कि संस्थामा अत्यन्त ठण्डा, खराब खाना र कठोर दण्ड थिए। 'हामी गन्दा थियौ। मलाई याद छ जब मैले आफ्नो बार गरेँ, ननहरूले मलाई एउटा ठूलो ठण्डो नहानमा डुबाए। त्यसपछि मैले ननहरूलाई पसन्द गर्न सकेन।'

article_content: Lord Hill, then Education Minister, attempted to resign from his post — but his resignation was effectively ignored by Prime Minister David Cameron. After several cancelled meetings, Hill finally secured a face-to-face audience with Cameron. What followed resembled a scene from the political satire 'The Thick Of It': Cameron, reportedly distracted, failed to register that Hill was offering his resignation. Instead of acknowledging the request, Cameron reportedly told him to 'keep up the good work' and hurried out of the room, citing a late photocall. Left bewildered, Hill remained in office. He later became the only member of Michael Gove’s team to survive a subsequent cabinet reshuffle. Hill, who previously served as a political secretary for Sir John Major and founded a PR firm, had confided in friends that he was exhausted after two years shepherding education bills through the House of Lords. When asked about the reshuffle, Cameron stated he had 'no intention of commenting,' adding, 'I am delighted to be at the Department for Education.' A Downing Street spokesperson declined to discuss private conversations between ministers.
translated_content: शिक्षा मन्त्री भएका लर्ड हिलले आफ्नो पदबाट इस्तीफा दिन खोज्यो — तर प्रधानमन्त्री डेभिड केमरनले उनको इस्तीफा बेवास्ता गरे। केही मिलेर रद्द भएका बैठकहरूपछि, हिलले केमरनसँग सीधा भेट गर्न सफल भए। त्यसपछि भएको घटना 'द थिक ऑफ इट' नामक राजनीतिक काल्पनिक कार्यक्रम जस्तो देखियो: केमरन, जसले अवधान गर्न सकेनन्, हिलले इस्तीफा दिएको बुझ्न सकेनन्। अनुरोधलाई स्वीकार गर्ने वा विरोध गर्ने कुराकानीको बजाय, केमरनले उनलाई 'अच्छो काम जारी राख्नुहोस्' भनेर भन्नुभयो र फोटोकलको लागि ढिला भएको बताएर कमराबाट निस्किए। बिचारबिमर्चमा रहेको हिल आफ्नो पदमा नै रहे। त्यसपछि उनी माइकल गोभको टोलीका मात्रै एकमात्र सदस्य बने जसले हालको मन्त्री पुनर्गठनमा बच्न सकेका थिए। हिल, जसले पहिले सर जॉन मेजरका लागि राजनीतिक सचिवको भूमिका निर्वाह गरेका थिए र एक पीआर कम्पनी स्थापना गरेका थिए, आफ्ना मित्रहरूलाई भन्नुभएको थियो कि उनी दुई वर्षसम्म संसदको उच्च सभामा शिक्षा बिलहरू पारित गर्ने काममा थकित भएका थिए। मन्त्री पुनर्गठनको बारेमा प्रश्न गर्दा, केमरनले 'म टिप्पणी गर्न इच्छुक छैनु' भन्नुभयो, र थपेर भन्नुभयो, 'म शिक्षा विभागमा हुनु खुशी छ।' डाउनिङ स्ट्रीटका प्रवक्ताले मन्त्रीहरूबीचको निजी छलफलको बारेमा टिप्पणी गर्न अस्वीकार गरे।

article_content: The Golden State Warriors extended their winning streak to 11 games — tying their franchise record set in the 1971-72 season — with a dominant 112-85 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Thursday night. Stephen Curry posted 19 points and a season-high 11 assists, while Klay Thompson led the team in scoring with 23 points. Harrison Barnes added a double-double with 17 points and 10 rebounds, and Draymond Green matched him with 14 points and 14 rebounds. Golden State, now 16-2, improved to an NBA-best record and secured their eighth consecutive win against the Pelicans. After a sluggish start, the Warriors surged with a 20-4 run in the second quarter to take control. Anthony Davis led New Orleans with 30 points and 15 rebounds in his 12th double-double of the season. In Cleveland, Kyrie Irving delivered a season-high 37 points, including a go-ahead layup with just 10 seconds remaining after a late timeout, to help the Cavaliers edge the New York Knicks 90-87 for their fifth straight win. LeBron James contributed 19 points and 12 assists, closing the game with five consecutive points to seal the victory. Despite efforts from Tim Hardaway Jr. (20 points) and Amare Stoudemire (18 points, 9 rebounds), the Knicks missed a potential game-winning three-pointer by Carmelo Anthony in the final seconds, dropping to 4-16 and extending their losing streak to six games. The Portland Trail Blazers snapped Indiana’s momentum with an 88-82 win, marking their third consecutive victory and 12th in their last 13 games. LaMarcus Aldridge recorded his fourth straight double-double with 18 points and 13 rebounds, while Damian Lillard led all scorers with 23 points. The Pacers, led by Rodney Stuckey’s 16 points, tied the game at 64 early in the fourth quarter but couldn’t overcome Portland’s late surge. A three-pointer by Nicolas Batum and a jumper from Lillard pushed the Blazers ahead 75-66. Though Stuckey cut the deficit to 83-80 with 53 seconds left, Indiana failed to close the gap.

article_content: Nico Rosberg has asked Formula One supporters to move on and let go of their anger after being booed on the podium for the second race in a row. The German driver, who finished second at both the Belgian and Italian Grands Prix, faced loud criticism from fans following on-track incidents with his Mercedes teammate Lewis Hamilton. At Monza, a mistake on lap 29 allowed Hamilton to overtake and claim victory — sparking frustration among Italian spectators who had already voiced their discontent in Spa. Rosberg, once widely admired for his calm demeanor, now finds himself cast as the villain in a storyline he never wanted. 'It’s not pleasant, but what can I do?' Rosberg said after the race. 'I’ve apologized. I can’t do more than that. I hope, with time, people forgive and forget.' Even Hamilton, who has experienced similar treatment in the past, admitted feeling uncomfortable hearing the crowd turn on Rosberg. Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff also stepped in, insisting podium booing has no place in the sport. 'These are athletes who gave everything,' Wolff said. 'Booing undermines the spirit of competition. We’re here to celebrate racing — not to punish drivers for close battles.' As emotions run high, Rosberg remains humble, hoping fans will remember the sport’s true values: respect, grit, and unity.

article_content: Nationwide support for Nigel Farage’s UKIP has reached an all-time high of 25%, according to a Survation poll commissioned by The Mail on Sunday. If replicated in a general election, this could enable UKIP to win over 100 seats, significantly weakening the Conservatives and potentially delivering victory to Labour under Ed Miliband. The poll follows UKIP’s strong performances in recent by-elections, including Clacton. While pollsters caution that support for minor parties often declines before general elections, this surge marks the clearest indication yet that UKIP may be poised for a major breakthrough. If current trends hold, the Conservatives could lose 100 seats, leaving David Cameron with just 187 — a position comparable to their 1997 defeat. Labour would gain 253 seats, while UKIP could secure 128, primarily from Conservative strongholds in southern England outside London, where support has risen by 34 percentage points since 2010. Professor John Curtice of Strathclyde University noted that while UKIP’s national vote share might not translate directly into seats under first-past-the-post, regional concentration in the South could make such gains feasible. A striking 58% of respondents agree with Farage’s call to ban HIV-positive immigrants from entering the UK — a policy that remains highly controversial. Yet, this view appears to resonate with a broad segment of the electorate. In a surprising twist, a Cameron-Farage partnership is the most preferred leadership combination among voters, even though Conservative supporters oppose formal electoral pacts with UKIP. Ed Miliband ranks poorly in leadership perceptions — seen as the fifth-best Labour leader since 1980 and behind both Theresa May and Nigel Farage in public trust. Meanwhile, Cameron is viewed as the second-most effective Conservative leader since Margaret Thatcher. Farage is also seen as the most trustworthy person to fix a shelf — but the least trusted to babysit, feed a pet, or bake a cake. One-third of respondents believe he is fit to serve as a Cabinet minister, with Immigration Minister being the most popular choice.

अझै विवादास्पद छ। तथापि, यो दृष्टिकोण चुनावी जनताको व्यापक खण्डसँग सम्बन्धित छ। अप्रत्याशित रूपमा, मतदाताहरूले क्यामरन-फर्राज संयुक्त नेतृत्वलाई सबैभन्दा बढी पसन्द गर्छन्, यद्यपि कन्सर्भेटिभ मतदाताहरूले यूकेआईपीसँग औपचारिक चुनावी समझौता गर्न विरोध गर्छन्। एड मिलिब्यान्डको नेतृत्वको दृष्टिकोण खराब छ — १९८० देखि लेबरको पाँचौं सर्वोत्तम नेता मानिन्छ, जुन थेरेसा मे र नेगिल फर्राज दुवैभन्दा पछि छ। तथापि, क्यामरनलाई मार्गारेट थ्याचर पछि दोस्रो सर्वोत्तम कन्सर्भेटिभ नेता मानिन्छ। फर्राजलाई शेल्फ ठीक गर्ने सबैभन्दा विश्वसनीय व्यक्ति मानिन्छ — तर बेबीसिट गर्न, पालतू जनावरलाई खुवाउन वा केक बनाउन न्यूनतम विश्वसनीय। तीन मध्ये एक जना मतदाताले उनलाई क्याबिनेट मन्त्री बन्न योग्य मान्छन्, जसमा अप्रवास मन्त्री सबैभन्दा लोकप्रिय छ।

article_content: Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin may be denied re-entry into the United States after renouncing his U.S. citizenship to reduce his tax liability, having relocated to Singapore ahead of Facebook’s highly anticipated IPO. Saverin, who held a $3.64 billion stake in Facebook at the time of the move, became a Singapore resident to take advantage of its zero capital gains tax policy — a strategic decision that drew scrutiny under U.S. immigration law. Under Section 212 of the Immigration and Nationality Act, a former U.S. citizen who renounces citizenship primarily to avoid U.S. taxation may be deemed excludable from the country. The U.S. State Department requires individuals renouncing citizenship to acknowledge this possibility in writing. Though Saverin’s spokesperson confirmed he renounced his U.S. citizenship in September 2011 — and was listed by the IRS in late April 2012 — he remains liable for an exit tax on unrealized capital gains from his Facebook shares, even without selling them. Saverin moved to the U.S. in 1992 and became a citizen in 1998. His decision to leave follows a broader trend of wealthy Americans relinquishing citizenship as tax rates rise — the top marginal rate was set to increase from 35% to 39.6% in 2013. In Singapore, Saverin has embraced a high-profile lifestyle, frequenting exclusive venues such as Filter, a private members club at the Conrad Hotel, and investing in startups like Qwiki, Jumio, and a cosmetics company founded by Rachel Kum, former Miss Singapore 2009. Despite his wealth, Saverin maintains extreme privacy, rarely gives interviews, and avoids public events — a contrast to Mark Zuckerberg, who leads a low-key life in Palo Alto, often seen in hoodies. Saverin’s early role in Facebook’s founding was dramatized in the 2010 film The Social Network, portrayed by Andrew Garfield. Though he originally held a one-third stake, legal disputes reduced his ownership to approximately 2%, still making him one of the world’s wealthiest individuals. The Facebook IPO, scheduled for May 18, 2012, priced shares at $28–$35 each, valuing the company at up to $79.3 billion — one of the largest tech IPOs since Google’s 2004 debut.

article_content: Hull City have officially brought in Senegalese forward Dame N'Doye from Russian club Lokomotiv Moscow for a fee of £3 million. The 29-year-old striker has signed a contract lasting two and a half years, with the club holding an option to extend it by another year. Manager Steve Bruce spent much of transfer deadline day in Paris, personally pushing to seal the deal before the window closed. N'Doye, who also represents Senegal internationally, has proven himself as a consistent scorer, netting 27 times in 66 league appearances for Lokomotiv. His arrival comes at a critical time for Hull, who have failed to find the back of the net in 12 of their last 16 matches. Bruce expressed clear enthusiasm about the acquisition, stating he’s thrilled to have secured N'Doye’s services and expects him to immediately elevate the team’s attacking options. 'He’ll bring real goal-scoring quality to the squad,' Bruce added, underscoring the hope that the new signing can turn around their struggling offense.

article_content: Jorge Lorenzo delivered a commanding performance at the Japanese Grand Prix in Motegi, winning Sunday’s race and dramatically narrowing the championship gap to rival Marc Marquez. Riding his Yamaha from start to finish, Lorenzo finished ahead of Marquez and his Honda teammate Dani Pedrosa, who came in second and third respectively. The result slashed Marquez’s championship lead to just 13 points with one race remaining—the first time in seven years the MotoGP title will be decided on the final weekend. 'As long as the checkered flag hasn't fallen, the championship isn't over,' Lorenzo said on the official MotoGP website. 'I’m not the leader, so it’s not all up to me. But I am the rider with the most wins in 2013—and that matters.' This marked Lorenzo’s 51st career victory and his seventh of the season. Marquez, just 20 years old and competing in his rookie season, had hoped to clinch the title in Honda’s home race but settled for second after a hard-fought battle. He acknowledged the pressure, saying, 'I knew I was pushing to the limit—I took 20 points for the championship.' The race unfolded under dry conditions after rain and fog disrupted practice and qualifying. Valentino Rossi, the Italian icon, recovered from early errors to finish sixth, behind Alvaro Bautista and Stefan Bradl in fourth and fifth. Marquez, who crashed in Saturday’s morning practice due to a cold tire and changing track temperatures, shook off the setback and finished just over three seconds behind Lorenzo.

article_content: ROME, Italy (CNN) — A sixth U.S. service member died Friday from injuries sustained when a Black Hawk helicopter crashed in northeastern Italy on Thursday, the U.S. military in Europe said. The helicopter, carrying 11 U.S. military personnel, crashed Thursday afternoon about 22 miles from Aviano, Italy. Four people were killed immediately, and seven were injured; two of the injured later died, according to the U.S. military. Treviso fire officials confirmed that one of the deceased was a woman and reported no injuries among people on the ground. The U.S. military stated the helicopter was an Army H-60 Black Hawk assigned to the 1st Battalion, 214th Aviation Regiment. Names of the deceased have not been released pending notification of their families. Police and fire officials said the aircraft crashed in an open area near the Piave River, north of Treviso, between the towns of Maserata sul Piave and Santa Lucia di Piave. Photos from the scene showed the helicopter crumpled and charred. Italy’s ANSA news agency reported the crash occurred near a bridge on a major highway, which was closed as a precaution. ANSA noted the helicopter had departed from Aviano Air Base, though fire authorities could not confirm whether it was departing or returning at the time. The Black Hawk is considered the workhorse of the U.S. military’s helicopter fleet, having been used for over three decades in missions including those in Iraq and Afghanistan. Its first combat deployment occurred roughly 25 years ago. CNN’s Hada Messia and Barbara Starr contributed to this report.
translated_content: रोम, इटली (सीएनएन) — शुक्रबार, एउटा ब्ल्याक हक चलाइएको हेलिकप्टर बुधबार उत्तरी इटलीमा दुर्घटनाग्रस्त भएपछि अमेरिकी सेवाकर्मीको छैटौं जना मृत्यु भएको अमेरिकी सैन्य युरोपले जनाएको छ। हेलिकप्टरमा ११ जना अमेरिकी सैन्य कर्मचारी थिए, जुन बुधबार दिउँसो इटलीको अभियानबाट लगभग २२ माइल दूर दुर्घटनाग्रस्त भएको थियो। चारजना तत्काल मृत्यु भएका थिए र सातजना घाइते भएका थिए; त्यसपछि दुई जना घाइतेहरू पनि मृत्यु भएका छन्, अमेरिकी सैन्यले भनेको छ। ट्रेभिसोका आगो अधिकारीहरूले एउटा मृतक महिला भएको पुष्टि गरे र भूमि मानिसहरूमा कुनै घाइतेको बारेमा जानकारी दिएका छैनन्। अमेरिकी सैन्यले भनेको छ कि हेलिकप्टर एउटा सेनाको एच-६० ब्ल्याक हक हो जुन १ बटालियन, २१४ एविएशन रेजिमेन्टसँग जोडिएको थियो। परिवारहरूलाई सूचित गर्ने प्रक्रिया पूरा नभएसम्म मृतकहरूको नाम खुलाउने गरिएको छैन। पुलिस र आगो अधिकारीहरूले भनेका छन् कि यो विमान ट्रेभिसोको उत्तरमा पियाभे नदीको नजिक, मसेराता सुल पियाभे र सान्ता लुसिया डि पियाभे बीचको खुला क्षेत्रमा दुर्घटनाग्रस्त भएको थियो। दुर्घटनाको स्थलबाट लिइएका फोटोहरूमा हेलिकप्टर टेकिएको र जलिएको देखिएको छ। इटलीको एएनएसए समाचार एजेन्सीले भनेको छ कि हेलिकप्टर एउटा प्रमुख राजमार्गको पुलको नजिक दुर्घटनाग्रस्त भएको थियो र सुरक्षाको लागि बाटो बन्द गरिएको थियो। एएनएसएले भनेको छ कि हेलिकप्टर अभियान एयर बेसबाट उड्नुभएको थियो, तर आगो अधिकारीहरूले यो उड्न वा फर्किरहेको थियो भन्ने पुष्टि गर्न सकेका छैनन्। ब्ल्याक हक अमेरिकी सैन्यको हेलिकप्टर बेडको कामकाजी ठूलो वाहन मानिन्छ, जुन इराक र अफगानिस्तान जस्ता मिशनहरूमा लगभग तीन दशकदेखि प्रयोग भइरहेको छ। यसको पहिलो युद्ध अभियान लगभग २५ वर्ष अघि भएको थियो। सीएनएनका हादा मेसिया र बार्बरा स्टारले यस रिपोर्टमा योगदान दिएका छन्।

article_content: Sonia Sotomayor, President Obama’s nominee to the U.S. Supreme Court, has earned the American Bar Association’s top rating of 'well qualified' — a significant endorsement just days before her Senate confirmation hearings begin. The ABA’s nonpartisan committee, which has assessed federal judicial nominees for over 50 years, unanimously concluded that Sotomayor possesses the integrity, competence, and temperament required for the nation’s highest court. This marks a strong upgrade from her 1998 appellate court nomination, when she received the same rating but without full consensus. Senate Judiciary Chair Patrick Leahy welcomed the result, suggesting it should quiet critics who’ve questioned her suitability. At 55, Sotomayor currently serves on the Second Circuit Court of Appeals and would fill the seat left by retiring Justice David Souter. The ABA emphasizes its evaluations examine only professional merit — not ideology or personal beliefs. Still, Republican leaders like Senator Mitch McConnell have voiced skepticism, zeroing in on her earlier ruling in a high-profile case involving New Haven firefighters. In that case, Sotomayor’s panel upheld the city’s decision to discard promotional exams after finding too few minority candidates would qualify. The Supreme Court later overturned her decision, sparking accusations from conservatives that she prioritizes empathy over impartiality. Critics argue this reflects a dangerous tendency to favor specific groups based on identity rather than legal principle. Meanwhile, past Republican administrations under Reagan, Bush Sr., and especially George W. Bush have dismissed ABA ratings, claiming institutional bias. Yet even under Bush, nominees like Chief Justice John Roberts and Justice Samuel Alito received the highest ABA rating — underscoring the organization’s consistency. Harriet Miers, whose 2005 nomination was withdrawn before ABA review, remains the lone exception. Officially, the ABA’s role is advisory, but its early access to nominee information gives it unique influence — a privilege recently restored by the current White House.
translated_content: सरकारी नामाङ्कित सोनिया सोटोमयोरले अमेरिकी बार संघको उच्चतम मूल्याङ्कन 'उत्कृष्ट योग्यता' प्राप्त गरेकी छिन्, जुन सिनेटमा उनको पुष्टि सुनुवाइ सुरु हुने एक हप्ताभित्र एक महत्वपूर्ण समर्थन हो। एबीएको निष्पक्ष समितिले अधिकारीहरूको नामाङ्कनको मूल्याङ्कन गर्ने ५० वर्षभन्दा बढी समय लिएको छ र आज अदालतको उच्चतम स्थानको लागि सोटोमयोर उत्कृष्ट योग्यता राख्छन् भनेर एकमतले निष्कर्ष निकाल्यो। यो उनको १९९८ को अपिल अदालतको नामाङ्कनबाट उत्कृष्ट उन्नति हो, जब उनलाई त्यही रेटिङ दिइएको थियो तर एकमत थिएन। सिनेट न्यायिक समितिका अध्यक्ष प्याट्रिक लेहीले यस मूल्याङ्कनलाई स्वागत गरेर भने, यसले सोटोमयोरको न्यायिक योग्यताको बारेमा संदेह राख्ने आलोचकहरूको संदेह निवारण गर्नुपर्छ। ५५ वर्षीय सोटोमयोर अहिले न्यूयोर्क स्थित दोस्रो अपिल अदालतमा काम गर्छन् र निष्क्रिय न्यायाधीश डेभिड सोटरको स्थान लिने छिन्। एबीएले आफ्नो मूल्याङ्कनमा नामाङ्कितको दर्शन वा विचारधारा नलिने भन्ने बारेमा जोड दिन्छ, तर केवल व्यावसायिक योग्यतामा। तथापि, रिपब्लिकन नेताहरू जस्तै सेनेटर मिट बेलकनले उनको न्यायिक व्यवहारको बारेमा संदेह व्यक्त गरेका छन्, विशेषगरी न्यू हेभन फायरफाइटर मामलामा उनको पहिलेको निर्णयमा। त्यस मामलामा, सोटोमयोरले शहरको फैसलालाई समर्थन गर्छन् जसले धेरै अल्पसंख्यकहरू उत्तीर्ण भएको देखि प्रमोशनको परीक्षा रद्द गर्यो। उच्च अदालतले अन्ततः उनको निर्णय उल्टाएको छ र संरक्षवादीहरूले उनलाई न्याय भन्दा सहानुभूतिलाई प्राथमिकता दिने आरोप लगाएका छन्। आलोचकहरूले भन्छन् कि यो विशिष्ट समूहहरूलाई व्यक्तिगत पहिचानका आधारमा बर्ष गर्ने खतरनाक प्रवृत्ति हो। तथापि, रिगन, बुश जुनियर र विशेषगरी जर्ज डब्ल्यू बुशका अतिरिक्त गणतन्त्रात्मक प्रशासनहरूले एबीएको मूल्याङ्कन अस्वीकार गरेका छन्, जसले संगठनलाई संस्थागत ढलान भन्ने आरोप लगाएका छन्। तर बुशको अवधिमा पनि चीफ जस्टिस जन रोबर्ट्स र जस्टिस सैमुअल अलिटो जस्ता नामाङ्कितहरूले उच्चतम एबीए रेटिङ पाएका थिए — जसले संगठनको स्थिरतालाई देखाउँछ। २००५ मा एबीएले मूल्याङ्कन गर्नु अघि नै हरियेट मियर्सको नामाङ्कन फिर्ता लिइएको थियो, जुन एकमात्र अपवाद हो। आधिकारिक रूपमा, एबीएको भूमिका सल्लाहकारी छ, तर नामाङ्कितहरूको जानकारी प्राप्त गर्ने यसको अग्रिम पहुँचले यसलाई अद्वितीय प्रभाव दिन्छ — जुन अहिलेको व्हाइट हाउसले फेरि स्वीकार गरेको छ।

article_content: Liam Barker, an 18-year-old boy born with myotubular myopathy — a rare, terminal muscle-wasting disease — has defied all medical expectations. Diagnosed at birth and given just three months to live, he has spent his entire life on life support, relying on a ventilator to breathe and his parents for round-the-clock care. Despite his profound physical limitations — he communicates solely through eye blinks and has never left his home except for hospital visits — Liam recently celebrated his 18th birthday, a milestone his family thought impossible. But this joy was shattered when the family received a letter from the Job Centre stating that Liam may need to attend a 'Work Capability Assessment' or a 'Work Focus Interview' to continue receiving Employment and Support Allowance. His mother, Michelle, also discovered that Liam’s child benefit payments had been abruptly halted two weeks earlier. His father, Phil Barker, described the letter as deeply offensive. When he called the Stockton Benefit Centre, he was asked bluntly: 'Can he work?' 'I tried explaining his condition,' Phil said. 'But the woman said it’s just a yes-or-no form. How is he supposed to attend an interview? He can’t speak. He can’t move. The only place he goes is the hospital.' The family argues that the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) already has access to Liam’s National Insurance records — which clearly show decades of disability benefit claims — yet failed to review them before issuing the demand. Phil added: 'After 18 years, surely they must know by now. If another disabled person had no carer, they’d be lost. This isn’t bureaucracy — it’s cruelty.' In response, a DWP spokesperson stated: 'As children grow, their needs change. The Work Capability Assessment evaluates what a person can do, not just what they can’t. Those found incapable of any work receive long-term support.' Yet for families like the Barkers, the process feels less like support and more like a humiliating ritual — one that fails to recognize the dignity and reality of lives lived entirely within the constraints of severe disability.
translated_content: लियम बर्कर, माइओटुबुलर मायोपैथीको साथ जन्मिएका १८ वर्षीय छोरा — एउटा दुर्लभ, अन्तिम पेशी क्षय रोग — ले सबै चिकित्सकीय अपेक्षाहरूलाई अतिक्रमण गरेका छन्। जन्मको समय नै निदान भएको र तीन महिनाभन्दा बढी बाँच्ने सम्भावना नभएको लियमले आफ्नो पूरा जीवन जीवन समर्थनमा बिताएका छन्, श्वासको लागि भेन्टिलेटरमा निर्भर छन् र आफ्ना आमाबाबुले घरमा निरन्तर देखभाल गर्छन्। आफ्नो गहिरो शारीरिक सीमाहरूको बावजूद — उनले केवल आँखाको झिपकी मारेर नै संचार गर्छन् र अस्पताल भित्र नै बाहिर जाने एकमात्र स्थान हो — लियमले हालको वर्ष आफ्नो १८ औँ जन्मदिन मनाएका थिए, जुन उनको परिवारले असम्भव मानेको थियो। तर यो खुशी त्यहीँ टुक्रियो जब परिवारलाई जॉब सेन्टरबाट एउटा पत्र पठाइएको थियो जसमा लियमले 'कार्य क्षमता मूल्याङ्कन' वा 'कार्य केन्द्रित साक्षात्कार' देखि गुजार्नुपर्ने बताइएको थियो ताकि उनले रोजगारी र समर्थन अनुदान प्राप्त गर्न सकून्। उनकी आमा, मिशेलले लियमको बच्चाको लागि अनुदान भुक्तानी दुई हप्ताअघि अचानक रोकिएको पाए। उनका बाबु, फिल बर्करले पत्रलाई गहिरो रूपमा अपमानजनक भने। जब उनले स्टक्टन बेनिफिट सेन्टरमा फोन गरे, उनलाई सीधा सोधियो: 'उनले काम गर्न सक्छन्?' 'मैले उनको बीमारीको बारेमा बताउने प्रयास गरें,' फिलले भने। 'तर महिलाले भनिन्, यो केवल हो वा छैनको फारम हो। उनले साक्षात्कारको लागि कसरी आउन सक्छन्? उनले कुनै पनि बोल्न सक्दैनन्। उनले हिँड्न सक्दैनन्। उनको एकमात्र जाने स्थान अस्पताल हो।' परिवारले तर्क गर्छन् कि रोजगारी र समर्थन विभाग (DWP) ले लियमको राष्ट्रिय बीमा नम्बर जान्छ — जुन दशकौंदेखि अपाङ्गता अनुदानको दावी देखाउँछ — तर यो आह्वान जारी गर्नुअघि ती रेकर्डहरू जाँच गर्न सकेको थिएन। फिलले थप्नुभयो: '१८ वर्षपछि, अहिले त तिमीलाई थाहा हुनुपर्छ। अर्को अपाङ्ग व्यक्तिले कारेकर नभएको छ भने, उनीहरू खोज्न असमर्थ हुन्थे। यो ब्यूरोक्रेसी होइन — यो क्रूरता हो।' प्रतिक्रियामा, DWP का एक प्रवक्ताले भने: 'बच्चाहरू ठूला हुँदै जान्छन्, उनीहरूको आवश्यकताहरू पनि समयको साथ बदलिन्छन्। कार्य क्षमता मूल्याङ्कनले व्यक्ति के गर्न सक्छन् भनेर निर्धारण गर्छ, केवल तिनीहरू के गर्न सक्दैनन् भनेर होइन। जसले कुनै काम गर्न सक्दैनन्, उनीहरूलाई लामो समयको अक्षमता समर्थन प्राप्त हुन्छ।' तर बर्कर परिवार जस्ता परिवारहरूको लागि, यो प्रक्रिया समर्थन भन्दा बरु अपमानजनक अनुष्ठान जस्तो लाग्छ — जुन गहिरो अपाङ्गताको सीमाहरूमा जीवन बिताउने मानिसहरूको गरिमा र वास्तविकतालाई सम्मान गर्दैन।

article_content: Court documents scheduled for release in February 2013 reveal that BP likely knew the true scale of the Deepwater Horizon oil spill within days—not months—as it had publicly claimed. Despite asserting full transparency with regulators and the public, internal communications now suggest the company deliberately downplayed the disaster’s severity. Kurt Mix, a former BP engineer facing felony charges for allegedly deleting text messages, is being defended with a collection of internal emails his lawyers say demonstrate his cooperation with authorities. Rather than implicating Mix, these documents point to a systematic effort by BP to conceal the spill’s real rate. Only two days after the April 2010 explosion that killed 11 crew members, Mix emailed a supervisor estimating the leak at 62,000 to 146,000 barrels per day. Within 48 hours, BP informed the U.S. Coast Guard the rate was just 1,000 barrels per day. A few days later, a Norwegian oil consultant, analyzing video footage provided by Mix, estimated the flow could reach 40,000 barrels daily. Still, BP’s then-CEO Bob Dudley publicly stood by the 5,000-barrel estimate, calling higher figures ‘scaremongering.’ Independent scientific analyses later confirmed the true flow averaged around 62,000 barrels per day during the early phase. In November 2012, BP pleaded guilty to 14 felony charges—including 11 counts of involuntary manslaughter and one for obstruction of justice—after admitting it misled Congress about the spill’s size. The company agreed to pay $4.5 billion in penalties, the largest environmental fine in U.S. history. Mix’s defense argues that deleting messages was not an act of cover-up, but routine data management—especially since he had already shared accurate estimates with federal investigators. His case may not clear BP, but it raises serious questions about who was truly responsible for the misinformation.

article_content: Before he passed away in May 2013, John ‘Jack’ Holden didn’t just write his obituary—he crafted a comedy special in print. Known for his sharp wit and love of mischief, Jack’s self-penned farewell has charmed thousands online, blending real honors with delightfully absurd lies. A decorated Marine Corps fighter pilot in World War II, he earned the Distinguished Flying Cross and Air Medal for bravery in combat, including over Okinawa. But in his obituary, he also claimed the ‘Distinguished Fleeing Cross’ for dodging women seeking child support—because, of course, he did. Jack spent decades working at Armstrong Cork and Hubley Toy Company before becoming an independent toy designer, all while maintaining memberships in elite clubs… until he got kicked out of the International Mickey Mouse Club for taking in stray cats. At Willow Valley Retirement Community, he published ‘The Wrinkle Valley News’ for years, entertaining fellow residents—who lovingly called themselves ‘inmates’—with jokes designed to help them embrace chaos. He was married to Elaine for 61 years until her passing a decade earlier. And yes, he joked about having ‘other wives recently,’ all of whom, he assured readers, weren’t real. His three daughters and son? ‘They’ve survived despite being related to me.’ His final words? ‘I’m really going to miss myself.’ Though packed with punchlines, the obit ends with a tender call: donate to Honor Flight, not flowers. Written years before his death, Jack’s legacy isn’t just in what he did—but how he chose to be remembered: laughing, loud, and utterly unforgettable.

'म आफैंलाई निकै याद गर्न जाँदैछु।' यो सबै हास्यले भरिएको अन्तिम समाचार अन्तमा एक मधुर अनुरोधसँग समाप्त भएको छ: फूलहरूको बदलामा होनर फ्लाइटलाई दान गर्नुहोस्। उनको मृत्युभन्दा वर्षौं अघि लेखिएको यो अन्तिम समाचारले ज्याकको विरासतलाई केवल उनले गर्नुभएको कामबाट बढी, उनले कसरी आफ्नो याद राख्न चाहेका थिए—हाँसिरहेको, ठूलो र अत्यन्त अविस्मरणीय।

article_content: Australia have ruled out fast bowler Mitchell Johnson from their lineup for the fourth Test against India due to a persistent hamstring issue. With the series already secured 2-0 — following two wins and one draw — the team is prioritizing Johnson’s long-term availability for the upcoming One-Day Internationals against England and India, and the ICC World Cup. Australia’s head coach, Darren Lehmann, stated: 'Mitchell is a vital part of our summer plans, and we want him 100% fit. We’re not taking any risks. This break is the best way for him to recharge and fully recover ahead of the Tri-Series.' Physiotherapist Alex Kountouris confirmed Johnson experienced right hamstring soreness during the Boxing Day Test in Melbourne and has not yet regained full fitness. As a result, he will miss the Sydney Test, which begins Tuesday at 10:30 AM local time. However, he is expected to be ready for the Tri-Series. Meanwhile, Australia’s captain Michael Clarke, sidelined since the first Test in Adelaide due to a hamstring injury, is making remarkable progress in his recovery. Following surgery, Clarke is reportedly a week ahead of schedule — having already resumed running and cycling. He remains hopeful of featuring in the World Cup opener against England on February 14, though he emphasizes his return will depend on medical clearance. Clarke, currently commentating for Channel Nine, has also used his column in the Daily Telegraph to pay tribute to former Indian captain MS Dhoni, who announced his retirement from Test cricket after the drawn third Test in Melbourne. 'Being captain of India’s cricket team is arguably one of the toughest roles in international sport,' Clarke wrote. 'Few have handled the pressure, scrutiny, and adoration better than MS Dhoni. Juggling captaincy, wicketkeeping, and all three formats? It’s beyond comprehension. He’s left a massive void in Indian cricket — one that will be incredibly hard to fill.' Dhoni’s final act in Test cricket came with a handshake after the drawn match, a quiet end to a legendary career.

यो मलाई अविश्वसनीय लाग्छ। उनले भारतीय टेस्ट टोलीमा ठूलो खाली ठाउँ छोड्नुभएको छ — जुन भर्न अत्यन्तै कठिन हुनेछ।' धोनीको टेस्ट क्रिकेटमा अन्तिम कार्य ड्र भएको खेलपछि एक हात मिलाउनु थियो — एउटा महान व्यक्तित्वको शान्त अन्त्य।

article_content: On Tuesday, Denny's handed out roughly 2 million free Grand Slam breakfasts during an eight-hour promotional window, drawing enormous crowds across North America. The surprise giveaway, announced during a Super Bowl ad, turned ordinary restaurant visits into chaotic, joyful events — with customers waiting up to an hour in line, sometimes sharing booths with strangers just to get their fill of pancakes, eggs, bacon, and sausage. With around 1,500 locations participating, each restaurant served an average of 130 Grand Slams per hour. CEO Nelson Marchioli called it ‘an extraordinary day,’ saying the campaign successfully reconnected the brand with millions of Americans. Staff and patrons alike shared heartfelt stories, reinforcing the emotional impact beyond the free food. Though Denny's didn’t reveal exact figures, the company estimates the entire promotion — including food, advertising, and logistics — cost about $5 million. Still, the meals given away carried a retail value of nearly $12 million, based on the usual $5.99 price tag. For context, Denny’s typically sells 12.5 million Grand Slams annually. Franchisee Troy Morgan explained that the real goal wasn’t just to give away meals, but to win loyal customers through exceptional service. Meanwhile, rival chain IHOP is preparing its own event: on February 24, National Pancake Day, it will offer free short stacks — but asks guests to donate to Children’s Miracle Network or other local charities in return.

article_content: A wealthy Minnesota couple, Colin Chisholm III, 62, and his wife Lady Andrea Chisholm, 54, of Deephaven, Minnesota, have been accused of fraudulently obtaining $165,000 in public assistance between 2005 and 2012. Authorities revealed Friday that they had $3 million hidden in various bank accounts when apprehended. The couple claimed to be impoverished Scottish aristocrats while residing on a $1.2 million yacht in Florida and later in a luxury lakeside home in Minnesota — neither of which they disclosed on welfare applications. They applied for over a dozen government benefits, including medical aid and food stamps, while concealing ownership of a $30,000 Lexus, a beach property in Florida, and a 5,800-square-foot home on Lake Minnetonka. Colin Chisholm III is listed as president and CEO of TCN Network, a satellite TV company serving the Caribbean, with over $1 million flowing through accounts under his control. Lady Chisholm operated Strathglass Kennel, breeding championship Cavalier King Charles Spaniels — also unreported. Investigators found that the couple lived with Lady Chisholm’s elderly grandparents in Deephaven from 2008 to 2009, during which time Lady Chisholm held power of attorney over their finances — a fact omitted from benefit forms. Hennepin County Attorney Mike Freeman stated at a press conference: 'It is truly outrageous when persons of considerable means steal from the government and all of us taxpayers through abusing the social welfare system. I will make sure they do hard time.' Prosecutors plan to seek prison sentences beyond Minnesota’s sentencing guidelines, citing the magnitude of the economic crime. The couple remains at large following a manhunt launched last month.

article_content: A cruise ship named the Ushuaia became stranded along the icy coastline of Antarctica on Thursday after hitting floating ice, Argentine authorities confirmed. Onboard were 89 passengers and 33 crew members. While the vessel began losing fuel and taking on water, officials emphasized it was not at risk of sinking. As a precautionary measure, Argentina’s Antarctic Directorate launched a naval vessel and a rescue aircraft to stand by for possible evacuation. Passengers, according to Admiral Daniel Martin of the Ushuaia naval base, are in excellent health and are waiting to be transferred to the Atlantic Dream—a nearby cruise ship dispatched to assist. Though the area is experiencing strong, gusty winds, the ship remains protected within a narrow strait, ensuring safe access for rescue assets. Positioned approximately 300 kilometers southwest of Argentina’s Marambio naval base in Antarctica, the Ushuaia is registered under the Panamanian flag. Local media outlets including C5N and TodoNoticias report no injuries or signs of distress among those aboard.

article_content: By Sam Webb Enemy of the State? Chippenham Mayor John Scragg Arrested in Russia for Photographing Public Transport An elderly mayor from the quiet market town of Chippenham in Wiltshire was detained in Russia after being suspected of terrorism—simply for taking photographs of trams and trolleybuses. John Scragg, 69, the first citizen of Chippenham and a lifelong public transport enthusiast, was led to a police station and interrogated after authorities discovered photos of him standing beside public transit vehicles. Despite his protests, he and another member of a 20-person tourist group were held for five hours and subjected to intense questioning. The pair feared they might be deported—or worse, sent to perform hard labor in Siberia. Eventually, Russian authorities concluded they were harmless tourists on an organized trip to Samara in south-eastern Russia and released them late at night. 'They couldn't understand why all our photos were of trams and trolleybuses instead of cathedrals,' Scragg said. 'They must have thought we were terrorists, photographing potential targets. I was terrified we'd be thrown out—or worse.' Scragg, who is serving his third term as mayor and has held the position since 1992 and 2005, is a member of the Liberal Democrats and sits on Chippenham Town Council. He studied at the London School of Economics and spent his career as a senior internal auditor and project finance officer. His official council profile lists his hobbies as 'overseas tramways, London and provincial buses, military history (air and land warfare from 1939),' and photography. He also represents the council on the Wiltshire County Council Parish Transport Group, advocating for improved local bus and rail services. Had Russian officials checked his public online profile, they would have seen no link to extremism—only a passionate collector of transit systems and military history.

article_content: Great-grandfather Reuben Day, 82, warned police after witnessing a V-2 rocket fall just off the coast of East Anglia in 1944. These weapons, fired by Nazi Germany from occupied Europe, killed thousands in the final months of World War II. At the time, Day — then a teenage fisherman — showed officers the unexploded missile lodged in the mud, but no action was taken. For 68 years, the 46-foot-long rocket remained largely undisturbed, with only its 2-foot tail visible at low tide. Occasionally, sailors used the protruding metal to moor their boats. Now, officials have decided it must be safely removed. A six-man team from the Royal Navy’s bomb disposal unit is working urgently to assess whether the one-ton warhead is still live. Day recalled hearing a 'terrific explosion' overhead, followed by black-and-white smoke and a white vapor trail. He later rowed out with a policeman, who fell into the mud — requiring Day to pull him out and retrieve his boots. Day sketched the rocket’s exposed tube and three brass dials inside, keeping a copy for himself. 'I heard nothing more about it,' he said. 'It has stayed there ever since.' The rocket is believed to have been aimed at Harwich in October 1944 but missed, embedding itself 600 feet offshore. A yellow buoy now marks its location near the Harwich and Dovercourt Sailing Club, established in 1927. Club members have navigated around the object for decades, treating it as a harmless obstacle. But after it was mentioned at a recent harbor meeting, police and naval experts intervened. Lieutenant Dan Herridge, commander of the Southern Diving Unit 2, said the find is unprecedented: 'I don’t think a V-2 has been discovered since the end of the war — certainly not in such good condition.' Experts from 33 Regiment Royal Engineers may need to excavate the missile from the mud. If deemed unstable, a controlled explosion at sea may be necessary. Though rusted for over 70 years, the rocket’s explosive components remain unpredictable. 'We must deal with it cautiously and with respect,' Herridge added. The V-2 was the world’s first long-range ballistic missile, capable of traveling over 3,500 mph and striking targets 200 miles away. Around 7,250 British citizens and service members died in V-2 attacks. Scientists behind the V-2 later contributed to U.S. and Soviet space programs. Essex Police say evacuation plans are premature, but some locals worry: 'If it’s still live, the whole town will have to be evacuated — and that will cause chaos.'

तीन तामा घडीहरू चित्रण गरे, र आफ्नो लागि एउटा प्रति बनाए। 'मलाई त्यसपछि केही पनि थाहा भएन,' उनले भने। 'यो त्यहीँ अछ।' यो मिसाइल ओक्टोबर १९४४ मा हार्विचलाई लक्ष्य बनाएर छोडिएको थियो, तर यो लक्ष्य छोडेर चलाएका छन्, यसलाई एउटा निष्क्रिय बाधा मानेर। तर ताजा बैठकमा यसको उल्लेख भएपछि प्रहरी र नौसेना विशेषज्ञहरूले हस्तक्षेप गरे। दक्षिणी डाइभिङ यूनिट २ का कमान्डर लेफ्टिनेन्ट ड्यान हर्रिज भन्छन्, 'मलाई लगायत विश्वयुद्धपछि भी-२ खोजिएको छैन — निश्चित रूपमा यति राम्रो अवस्थामा छैन।' ३३ रेजिमेन्ट रॉयल इन्जिनियर्सका विशेषज्ञहरूले मिसाइललाई बालुवाबाट खोद्न आवश्यक पर्न सक्छ। यदि अस्थिर भएको ठहरियो भने, समुद्रमा नियन्त्रित विस्फोट गर्न सकिन्छ। ७० वर्षभन्दा बढी जंग लागेपनि, मिसाइलको विस्फोटक घटकहरू अझै अनिश्चित छन्। 'हामीले यसलाई सावधानीपूर्वक र सम्मानसँग निस्कारा गर्नुपर्छ,' हर्रिजले थप्नुभयो। भी-२ विश्वको पहिलो लम्बो दूरीको बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल थियो, जसले ३,५०० मिल प्रति घण्टामा यात्रा गर्न सक्छ र २०० मिल दूरीमा लक्ष्य ठोक्न सक्छ। भी-२ हमलाहरूमा लगभग ७,२५० ब्रिटिश नागरिक र सेवाकर्मी मारिएका थिए। भी-२ का वैज्ञानिकहरूले पछि अमेरिकी र सोभियत अन्तरिक्ष कार्यक्रमहरूमा महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेले। एसेक्स प्रहरीले निकासी योजनाको बारेमा अहिले निर्णय गर्न अझै ढिलो भन्छन्, तर केही स्थानीयहरू चिन्तित छन्: Violence isn’t always physical — and the UK Home Secretary Theresa May’s recent extradition decisions have delivered devastating blows to an already marginalized Muslim community. On October 5, five Muslim men were extradited to the United States. Days later, the government blocked the extradition of British hacker Gary McKinnon. For many in the UK’s Muslim communities, this contrast was not surprising — but it was deeply painful. These communities have long endured aggressive anti-terror policies: repeated stop-and-searches, detention without charge, demonization of their faith, and relentless social exclusion. Many hoped that quiet resilience and displays of patriotism — waving Union flags at protests, appealing to ideals of citizenship — would lead to fairness. Instead, they’ve been met with indifference. Others have openly condemned institutional racism. Still others, lacking strong leadership, simply try to survive — silenced, aggrieved, and treated as outsiders in a nation whose legal systems were once exported globally under colonial rule, now repackaged as 'freedom' and 'human rights.'

This may sound angry — but it reflects a long-overdue reckoning. The disparity in treatment stems from decades of harmful misrepresentation. While the British media endlessly debated whether extraditing McKinnon violated his human rights, coverage of the Muslim men focused only on why their extradition took so long. Few dispute that McKinnon and his family suffered immensely — and most agree he should not have been sent to the US. But the families of the five Muslim men suffered equally: six to fourteen years in prison without charge. Yet their names are rarely spoken. On the day of their final appeals, headlines read: 'Abu Hamza and four others.' Abu Hamza, long portrayed as the archetype of the dangerous Muslim, became the symbolic face of the UK’s surrender of legal sovereignty under the 2003 extradition treaty.

Anti-Muslim prejudice predates 9/11 — visible in news reports, literature, film, and even pop culture like Bridget Jones. Stereotypes of violent men, oppressed women, irrational beliefs, and 'exotic' behaviors have normalized dehumanization. The extradition of Talha Ahsan and the reprieve of Gary McKinnon are direct outcomes of this bias. Though both men share Asperger’s Syndrome, were deemed suicide risks, and faced identical legal procedures, only McKinnon was seen as worthy of protection. McKinnon admitted hacking Pentagon systems; Ahsan denies the charges. One is viewed as a person deserving rights; the other, as a threat beyond humanity. The answer to 'Why Talha, not Gary?' is simple: racism.

हिंसा सधैँ शारीरिक हुन्छैन — र यूके को घरेलु मन्त्री थेरेसा मे को हालको निकासी निर्णयहरूले पहिले नै बेचारा भएको मुस्लिम समुदायलाई ठूलो झट्का दिएको छ। अक्टोबर ५ को दिन पाँचजना मुस्लिम पुरुषहरूलाई अमेरिकामा निकालिएको थियो। केही दिन पछि, सरकारले ब्रिटिश ह्याकर गेरी म्याकिननको निकासी रोकिएको थियो। यूके को मुस्लिम समुदायका धेरैलाई यो तुलना आश्चर्यजनक थिएन — तर यो गहिरो दुखद थियो। यी समुदायहरूले दशकौं देखि अत्याचारी आतंकवाद विरुद्धका नीतिहरू: बारम्बार रोक र खोजी, बिना आरोप जेलमा राख्ने, आफ्नो धर्मलाई दुषित गर्ने, र असहनशील सामाजिक विभेद झेल्नु परेको छ। धेरैले चुपचाप झेल्ने र राष्ट्रियताको निर्देशन गर्ने (उत्सवमा यूनियन झण्डा उडाउने, नागरिकताको अवधारणामा आह्वान गर्ने) ले न्याय पाउने आशा गरे। तर तिनीहरूलाई उपेक्षा मात्र मिल्यो। अरूले संस्थागत नस्लीय भेदभावलाई स्पष्ट रूपमा चिनाए। अरू अझ, राम्रो नेतृत्व नभएको कारण, बस्न खोज्दैछन् — चुपचाप, दुखी, र आफ्नो कानूनी प्रणालीलाई उपनिवेशवादी प्रयासबाट विश्वभर बाहिर निकालिएको, अब 'स्वतन्त्रता' र 'मानव अधिकार' को नाममा दमन गर्ने समाजमा बाहिरीहरूको रूपमा।

यो गुस्सैले भरिएको लाग्छ — तर यो लामो समयदेखि आउन बाँकी रहेको एक नयाँ मूडलाई प्रतिबिम्बित गर्छ। उपचारको असमानता दशकौंदेखि भएको हानिकारक प्रतिनिधित्वबाट उत्पन्न भएको हो। जबकि ब्रिटिश मिडियाले म्याकिननको निकासीले उनको मानव अधिकार उल्लंघन गर्छ कि भनेर अनन्त रूपमा चर्चा गर्यो, मुस्लिम पुरुषहरूको निकासीको बारेमा केवल तिनीहरूको निकासी किन इतनो ढिलो भयो भन्ने कुरामा ध्यान केन्द्रित भयो। म्याकिनन र उनको परिवारले अत्यधिक दुःख झेलेको छ — र यूके मा धेरैले उनलाई अमेरिकामा निकाल्ने निर्णयलाई विरोध गर्छन्। तर पाँचजना मुस्लिम पुरुषहरूका परिवारहरूले पनि समान दुःख झेलेका छन्: छ देखि चौद्द वर्षसम्म बिना आरोप जेलमा। तर तिनीहरूका नामहरू कहिल्यै उच्चारण गरिएको छैन। उनीहरूको अन्तिम अपीलको दिन, हेडलाइनहरूले 'अबू हम्जा र अरू चारजना' भन्ने लेखेका थिए। अबू हम्जा, जसलाई लामो समयदेखि खतरनाक मुस्लिमको उदाहरणको रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको थियो, २००३ को यूके-अमेरिका निकासी सम्झौताको तह छोड्ने यूके को प्रतीक बनिसकेका छन्।

९/११ अघि नै मुस्लिम विरुद्धको भेदभाव थियो — समाचार रिपोर्ट, साहित्य, फिल्म, र ब्रिजेट जोन्स जस्ता पप कल्चरमा पनि देखिन्छ। हिंसक पुरुष, दमित नारी, अतर्की विश्वास, र 'विदेशी' व्यवहारका स्टेरियोटाइपहरूले मानवताको अवमूल्यनलाई सामान्य बनाएका छन्। तल्हा अहसानको निकासी र गेरी म्याकिननको बचाव यही प्रक्रियाका अन्तिम उत्पादनहरू हुन्। दुवै व्यक्तिहरूले एस्पर्जर सिन्ड्रोम भोगेका छन्, आत्महत्याको जोखिम रहेको चिनाइएको थियो, र समान कानूनी प्रक्रिया झेलेका छन्, तर केवल म्याकिननलाई रक्षा गर्ने योग्य व्यक्ति मानिएको थियो। म्याकिननले पेन्टागनमा ह्याक गरेको स्वीकार गर्छन्; अहसानले आरोपहरू निन्दा गर्छन्। एकलाई मानव अधिकार भएको व्यक्ति मानिन्छ; अर्कालाई मानवताबाहिरको खतरा मानिन्छ। 'किन तल्हा, म्याकिनन होइन?' भन्ने प्रश्नको एक शब्दमा उत्तर: नस्लीय भेदभाव।

article_content: Somalia’s transitional president, Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, has urgently appealed to the international community for support in combating foreign Islamist militants operating in the lawless Horn of Africa nation. Speaking at a news conference in Mogadishu, Ahmed warned that these militants — whom he identifies as the same fighters active in Iraq and Afghanistan — are fueling violence and threatening to turn Somalia into another failed state. 'The Somali people cannot and should not accept their country being used as a launchpad for attacks,' he said. Ahmed commended local militias in the regions of Hiiran and Middle Shabelle for their resistance against these foreign fighters. Last week, al-Shabab militants advanced toward the presidential palace, triggering intense clashes that have left over 40 civilians dead and 150 wounded, according to eyewitnesses. Once the armed wing of the Islamic Courts Union, al-Shabab has been designated a terrorist organization by the United States due to its ties to al-Qaeda. Ahmed, who helped lead the Islamic Courts Union’s takeover of Mogadishu in 2006 before it was ousted by Ethiopian forces, has since distanced himself from jihadist movements and was appointed president through a UN-backed transition process. Journalist Mohamed Amiin Adow contributed to this report.

article_content: By Kerry McQueeney. Published: 11:50 EST, 12 July 2012. Updated: 20:37 EST, 12 July 2012. An art student triggered a terror alert in central London today after leaving a bomb-like backpack — complete with trailing wires — at her college. Students from Central Saint Martins were evacuated from the campus on Back Hill, Clerkenwell, after the suspicious package was reported to police. The item, described as an art project titled 'Intervention,' was reportedly placed in the reception area by the student as part of an installation. Police, already on high alert due to the upcoming London 2012 Olympic Games, swiftly responded with terror response units, evacuating the building and blocking surrounding streets. Once authorities confirmed the backpack was a hoax, the student — identified as Young Choo — was given a stern warning. A Scotland Yard spokesperson told MailOnline: 'We responded to reports of a suspicious package at approximately 1:30 p.m. at Central Saint Martins on Back Hill. Several people were evacuated before it was determined to be non-threatening. Advice was given to the student.' Choo, an American participating in a summer study abroad program, said she left the device as part of her project before going to lunch. The convincing prop consisted of a black backpack wrapped in red tape, containing a canister and exposed wires. When she returned, police questioned her and required her to dismantle the prop in a nearby bin. She was not charged and was permitted to leave. Choo is studying Contemporary Fine Art Practice, a course described by the college as 'an interdisciplinary fine art program that provides an innovative and experimental approach to the making and development of your work.' Central Saint Martins declined to comment.

article_content: In a remarkable encounter beneath the icy waters of Antarctica, wildlife photographer Paul Nicklen found himself face-to-face with a 12-foot-long leopard seal — an apex predator known for its power and ferocity. Initially terrified, Nicklen described how the seal approached him with open jaws, nearly engulfing his camera and head. Yet instead of attacking, the seal soon began exhibiting unusual behavior: repeatedly returning with penguins — alive, injured, and dead — nudging them toward his camera. Nicklen speculated that the seal may have been practicing hunting behaviors, possibly mistaking his camera for a mouth or mimicking the prey-delivery actions seen in maternal teaching among seals. 'Just as a penguin doesn’t know it’s cute, a leopard seal doesn’t realize how monstrous it looks,' Nicklen said. 'This is simply the food chain in action.' The 44-year-old Canadian photographer, who has documented wildlife across the globe, called this experience the most profound of his career. 'When you enter the water with a wild animal, you surrender control. You’re at their mercy,' he reflected. 'I was shaking, my mouth was dry — but the moment she dropped the penguin and came to me, everything changed.' While the encounter was widely shared as a touching bond between human and wild animal, scientists urge caution against anthropomorphizing predator behavior. Leopard seals are highly intelligent and curious, but their interactions with humans remain instinct-driven and potentially hazardous.

article_content: As Hurricane Sandy sweeps up the U.S. East Coast, air travel has ground to a near standstill. Over 14,000 flights have been canceled across the past two days — and more are expected as the storm intensifies. Major hubs like New York’s JFK, LaGuardia, and Newark are completely shut down, with airlines urging passengers not to even show up at the terminals. JetBlue, United, American, and Delta have all scrubbed hundreds to over a thousand flights each, stretching from Sunday through Wednesday. Tens of thousands of travelers are now stranded worldwide — not just in the U.S., but in cities like Hong Kong, London, and Tokyo, where flights bound for the Northeast have been axed. One businessman, Alan Shrem, found himself stuck in Hong Kong after his Cathay Pacific flight to JFK was canceled. His next available seat isn’t until November 4 — meaning he could be stranded for nearly a week. He’s paying $400 a night for a hotel, and his airline won’t cover it, since the delay is due to weather. Rail travel hasn’t fared better. Amtrak has suspended all service in the Northeast, including high-speed Acela and regional lines connecting Boston to Florida and Chicago. Passengers are being told to check Amtrak’s website or social media for updates — but no resumption date has been announced. Those who already paid but didn’t travel can get refunds or vouchers. Meanwhile, the New York Stock Exchange closed its iconic trading floor Monday and Tuesday — though electronic trading continues. It’s only the third time since 1985 that weather has forced a shutdown, and the first time since Hurricane Irene in 2011. Back then, 14,000 flights were canceled over four days. This time, experts warn Sandy’s merger with a cold front and winter storm could make the disruption far worse. Every major U.S. airline has relaxed its policies, allowing free changes to bookings. But travelers are still left scrambling. Eileen Merberg, a professor from Rochester, spent hours on the phone trying to rebook her flight to New Orleans. After two canceled connections, she gave up — and missed her speaking engagement. Many others faced similar frustrations: call centers overwhelmed, rebooking systems overloaded, and no clear answers. The storm is currently about 500 kilometers southeast of New York, packing 85 mph winds. Forecasters say it’s on course to slam into the mid-Atlantic coast tonight, bringing torrential rain, coastal flooding, and powerful winds. Schools are closed, subways are shut down, and New Yorkers are being told to stay indoors. As Sandy grows more dangerous, the full scale of chaos — economic, logistical, and personal — is only beginning to unfold.
translated_content: हरिकेन सान्डीले अमेरिकाको पूर्वी तटलाई आक्रमण गर्दै गएको छ, जसले हवाई यातायातलाई लगभग रोक्यो। पछिल्ला दुई दिनमा १४,००० भन्दा बढी उडानहरू रद्द भएका छन् — र त्यो संख्या बढ्ने अपेक्षा छ किनभने तूफान बलियो हुँदै गएको छ। न्यूयोर्कका प्रमुख हबहरू जस्तै जेएफके, लागुआर्डिया र न्यूअर्कले पूरै उडानहरू रोकेका छन्, र एयरलाइनहरूले यात्रीहरूलाई विमानस्थलमा आउनु हुँदैन भन्न चाहेका छन्। जेटब्लू, युनाइटेड, अमेरिकन र डेल्टाले रविबारदेखि बुधबारसम्म प्रत्येकले सयौं वा हजारौं उडानहरू रद्द गरेका छन्। दुनिया भरि लाखौं यात्रीहरू फसेका छन् — केवल अमेरिकामा होइन, तर हाङकाङ, लन्डन र टोकियो जस्ता शहरहरूमा पनि, जहाँ पूर्वी उत्तरको लागि उडानहरू रद्द भएका छन्। एक व्यापारी, अलन श्रेम, आफ्नो कैथेस पसिफिक उडान जेएफकेमा रद्द भएपछि हाङकाङमा फसेका थिए। उनको अर्को उपलब्ध सीट नोभेम्बर ४ सम्म छैन — अर्थात् उनी लगभग एक हप्ता सम्म फस्न सक्छन्। उनले एक रातको लागि ४०० डलर बासा दिनुपर्छ, र उनको एयरलाइनले यो खर्च वहन गर्दैन किनभने ढिलाइ मौसमसँग सम्बन्धित छ। रेल यातायात पनि ठूलो समस्यामा परेको छ। अमेरिकाको एमट्राकले पूर्वी उत्तरको सबै सेवा स्थगित गरेको छ, जसले बोस्टनदेखि फ्लोरिडा र चिकागोसम्मका उच्च गति एसिला र स्थानीय ट्रेनहरू समावेश गर्छ। यात्रीहरूलाई एमट्राकको वेबसाइट वा सामाजिक माध्यममा अपडेट देख्न भनिएको छ — तर कहिले सेवा फर्कने भन्ने कुनै तारिख घोषणा गरिएको छैन। जसले बुक गरेका थिए तर यात्रा गरेनन्, उनीहरूलाई रिफन्ड वा भविष्यको यात्राको लागि वाउचर दिइनेछ। त्यसैबेला, न्यूयोर्क स्टक एक्सचेञ्जले आफ्नो प्रसिद्ध ट्रेडिङ फ्लोर शनिबार र रविबार बन्द गरेको छ — तर इलेक्ट्रोनिक ट्रेडिङ जारी छ। १९८५ पछि यो तेस्रो पटक मौसमले बन्द गराएको छ, र २०११ मा हरिकेन आइरिन पछि पहिलो पटक हो। त्यो समय, चार दिनमा १४,००० उडानहरू रद्द भएका थिए। यसपटक, विशेषज्ञहरूले चेतावनी दिएका छन् कि सान्डीको शीतल हवा र शीतकालीन तूफानसँगको मिलनले यो अवरोध धेरै ठूलो बन्न सक्छ। प्रत्येक प्रमुख अमेरिकी एयरलाइनले आफ्नो नीति ढिलो गरेको छ, जसले बुकिङ बिना जरिवाना परिवर्तन गर्न अनुमति दिन्छ। तर यात्रीहरू अझै परेशान छन्। रोचेस्टरबाटकी शिक्षक एलिन मर्बर्गले न्यू ओर्लियान्सको लागि युनाइटेड उडान बुक गरेकी थिइन्, तर दुई वटा उडानहरू रद्द भएपछि उनले अनुमति लिन थालिन् — र आफ्नो भाषण गुमाए। धेरै अरूले पनि यस्तै समस्या भोगेका छन्: फोन सेन्टरहरू भरिएका, रिबुकिङ प्रणाली अतिभारित, र कुनै स्पष्ट जवाफ छैन। तूफान अहिले न्यूयोर्क शहरको दक्षिण-पूर्वमा लगभग ५०० किमी दूर छ, जसको लगातार ८५ माइल प्रति घण्टा झोल छ। अनुमानकर्ताहरूले भन्छन् कि तूफान आज राति मिड-अटलान्टिक तटलाई आघात गर्ने छ, जसले भारी वर्षा, तटीय बाढी र शक्तिशाली हवा ल्याउनेछ। विद्यालयहरू बन्द छन्, सबवे बन्द छन्, र न्यूयोर्कवासीहरूलाई घरमा रहन भनिएको छ। सान्डी खतरनाक हुँदै गएको छ, र आर्थिक, तार्किक र व्यक्तिगत स्तरमा पूर्ण अराजकताको पैमाना अझै शुरू भएको छ।

article_content: Newcastle United are moving quickly to secure midfielder Moussa Sissoko’s future by drafting a new contract offer, despite early signals of interest from Arsenal. The 25-year-old French international has been instrumental in revitalizing Alan Pardew’s team this campaign, showcasing grit and vision in midfield — even though he received a red card in Saturday’s loss to West Ham after losing his cool. Arsenal are scouting for a dynamic, ball-winning midfielder who can bridge defense and attack, and Sissoko fits that profile. Still, Newcastle are determined to keep him, especially with Cheick Tiote drawing attention from Russian clubs and a potential January bid looming. Though Sissoko still has four years remaining on his current deal, the club sees his recent form as worthy of a financial uplift. Meanwhile, Newcastle continue to track Burnley’s Danny Ings and MK Dons’ rising star Dele Alli, who has also attracted interest from Liverpool and Brentford. However, they don’t expect Ings to leave Burnley before his contract expires. Everton’s James McCarthy is also on Arsenal’s radar, but both clubs are firm: no sales in January, regardless of the offer.
